name: Universal Scripts
desc: Universal Roblox scripts, admin command panels, and game-agnostic utilities engineered to work across any Roblox experience.

scripts.title: Avatar copi.
scripts.script:
local SOURCE = [[
return function(INITIAL_SNAPSHOT, ENGINE_SOURCE)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
local key = "LocalAvatarDisguise"

if env.LocalAvatarReplicatedIdle then env.LocalAvatarReplicatedIdle:Stop() end
if env[key] then env[key]:Stop() end

local state = {
    connections = {}, avatarConnections = {}, hidden = {}, tracks = {},
    version = 0, stopped = false, exportCount = 0
}
env[key] = state

function state:ClearAvatar()
    for _, c in ipairs(self.avatarConnections) do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self.avatarConnections)
    if self.sharedTrack then
        pcall(function() self.sharedTrack:Stop(0.15) self.sharedTrack:Destroy() end)
        self.sharedTrack = nil
    end
    if self.sharedAnimation then self.sharedAnimation:Destroy() self.sharedAnimation = nil end
    for _, track in pairs(self.tracks) do
        pcall(function() track:Stop(0) track:Destroy() end)
    end
    table.clear(self.tracks)
    if self.model then self.model:Destroy() self.model = nil end
    for object, transparency in pairs(self.hidden) do
        if object.Parent then
            pcall(function() object.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency end)
        end
    end
    table.clear(self.hidden)
end

function state:Clear() self:ClearAvatar() end

function state:Stop()
    self.stopped = true
    self.version = self.version + 1
    self.selectedSnapshot = nil
    self:ClearAvatar()
    for _, c in ipairs(self.connections) do c:Disconnect() end
    if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end
    if env[key] == self then env[key] = nil end
end

local function connect(signal, callback, avatar)
    local c = signal:Connect(callback)
    table.insert(avatar and state.avatarConnections or state.connections, c)
    return c
end

local function create(class, properties, parent)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    for property, value in pairs(properties) do object[property] = value end
    object.Parent = parent
    return object
end

local function corner(object)
    create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)}, object)
end

local gui = create("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "LocalAvatarChanger", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 100,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
state.gui = gui

local window = create("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 293), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.12, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 25, 32), BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true
}, gui)
corner(window)
create("UIStroke", {Color = Color3.fromRGB(66, 68, 85)}, window)
local title = create("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 42), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Avatar Changer + Export", Active = true,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
}, window)
local close = create("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32), Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 5),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "×", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextSize = 25, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 188, 205)
}, window)
local input = create("TextBox", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 42), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 49),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 37, 48), BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Text = INITIAL_SNAPSHOT and INITIAL_SNAPSHOT.Username or "2Sh0rt4y0u",
    PlaceholderText = "Roblox username", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
}, window)
corner(input)

local function button(text, x, y, width, parent)
    local b = create("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width or 131, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y),
        BackgroundColor3 = text == "Apply" and Color3.fromRGB(111, 83, 230)
            or Color3.fromRGB(47, 49, 63), BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13,
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    }, parent or window)
    corner(b)
    return b
end
local applyButton = button("Apply", 14, 101)
local restoreButton = button("Restore", 155, 101)
local saveButton = button("Save script", 14, 146)
local copyButton = button("Copy script", 155, 146)
local idsButton = button("View all IDs", 14, 191, 272)
local status = create("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 52), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 234),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Apply an avatar to capture its IDs.",
    TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)
}, window)

local function setStatus(message, failed)
    if state.stopped then return end
    status.Text = message
    status.TextColor3 = failed and Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 145)
        or Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)
end

local dragging, dragStart, startPosition
connect(title.InputBegan, function(event)
    if event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        or event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging, dragStart, startPosition = event, event.Position, window.Position
    end
end)
connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(event)
    if dragging and (event == dragging or (
        dragging.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and event.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
        local delta = event.Position - dragStart
        window.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)
connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(event)
    if event == dragging then dragging = nil end
end)

local previewScroll = create("ScrollingFrame", {

local previewText = create("TextBox", {

    TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 220, 235), ZIndex = 12
}, previewScroll)
connect(previewClose.Activated, function() preview.Visible = false end)
local function showText(name, text)
    previewTitle.Text, previewText.Text = name, text
    previewScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
    preview.Visible = true
end

local properties = {
    "BackAccessory", "BodyTypeScale", "ClimbAnimation", "DepthScale", "Face",
    "FaceAccessory", "FallAnimation", "FrontAccessory", "GraphicTShirt",
    "HairAccessory", "HatAccessory", "Head", "HeadColor", "HeadScale",
    "HeightScale", "IdleAnimation", "JumpAnimation", "LeftArm", "LeftArmColor",
    "LeftLeg", "LeftLegColor", "MoodAnimation", "NeckAccessory", "Pants",
    "ProportionScale", "RightArm", "RightArmColor", "RightLeg", "RightLegColor",
    "RunAnimation", "Shirt", "ShouldersAccessory", "StaticFacialAnimation",
    "SwimAnimation", "Torso", "TorsoColor", "UseAvatarSettings", "WaistAccessory",
    "WalkAnimation", "WidthScale"
}
local childProperties = {
    AccessoryDescription = {"AssetId", "AccessoryType", "IsLayered", "Order",
        "Position", "Rotation", "Scale", "Puffiness"},
    BodyPartDescription = {"AssetId", "BodyPart", "Color", "HeadShape"}
}

local function pack(value)
    local kind = typeof(value)
    if kind == "Color3" then
        return {__type = "Color3", Values = {value.R, value.G, value.B}}
    elseif kind == "Vector3" then
        return {__type = "Vector3", Values = {value.X, value.Y, value.Z}}
    elseif kind == "EnumItem" then
        return {__type = "EnumItem", Enum = tostring(value.EnumType):gsub("^Enum%.", ""), Name = value.Name}
    elseif kind == "table" then
        local result = {}
        for k, item in pairs(value) do result[k] = pack(item) end
        return result
    elseif kind == "string" or kind == "number" or kind == "boolean" then
        return value
    end
    error("Unsupported snapshot value: " .. kind)
end

local function unpackValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    if value.__type == "Color3" then return Color3.new(value.Values[1], value.Values[2], value.Values[3]) end
    if value.__type == "Vector3" then return Vector3.new(value.Values[1], value.Values[2], value.Values[3]) end
    if value.__type == "EnumItem" then return Enum[value.Enum][value.Name] end
    local result = {}
    for k, item in pairs(value) do result[k] = unpackValue(item) end
    return result
end

local function capture(description, username, userId, rigType)
    local snapshot = {
        Version = 1, Username = username, UserId = userId, RigType = rigType.Name,
        CapturedAt = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), Properties = {}, Children = {},
        Accessories = pack(description:GetAccessories(true)),
        Emotes = pack(description:GetEmotes()),
        EquippedEmotes = pack(description:GetEquippedEmotes())
    }
    for _, property in ipairs(properties) do
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return description[property] end)
        if ok then snapshot.Properties[property] = pack(value) end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(description:GetChildren()) do
        local list = childProperties[child.ClassName]
        if list then
            local record = {ClassName = child.ClassName, Properties = {}}
            for _, property in ipairs(list) do
                local ok, value = pcall(function() return child[property] end)
                if ok then record.Properties[property] = pack(value) end
            end
            table.insert(snapshot.Children, record)
        end
    end
    return snapshot
end

local function restoreDescription(snapshot)
    assert(snapshot.Version == 1, "Unsupported snapshot version.")
    local description = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
    for property, value in pairs(snapshot.Properties) do
        local ok, err = pcall(function() description[property] = unpackValue(value) end)
        if not ok then warn("Snapshot property " .. property .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
    end
    description:SetAccessories(unpackValue(snapshot.Accessories or {}), true)
    description:SetEmotes(unpackValue(snapshot.Emotes or {}))
    description:SetEquippedEmotes(unpackValue(snapshot.EquippedEmotes or {}))
    local used = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(snapshot.Children or {}) do
        local p = record.Properties
        local selected
        for _, child in ipairs(description:GetChildren()) do
            if not used[child] and child.ClassName == record.ClassName then
                if record.ClassName == "AccessoryDescription" then
                    if child.AssetId == p.AssetId
                        and child.AccessoryType == unpackValue(p.AccessoryType) then selected = child end
                elseif record.ClassName == "BodyPartDescription" then
                    if child.BodyPart == unpackValue(p.BodyPart) then selected = child end
                end
                if selected then break end
            end
        end
        if not selected then selected = Instance.new(record.ClassName) end
        used[selected] = true
        for property, value in pairs(p) do
            local ok, err = pcall(function() selected[property] = unpackValue(value) end)
            if not ok then warn("Snapshot child " .. property .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
        end
        selected.Parent = description
    end
    return description
end

local defaults = {
    R15 = {idle = 507766666, walk = 507777826, run = 507767714, jump = 507765000,
        fall = 507767968, climb = 507765644, swim = 507784897, swimidle = 507785072, sit = 2506281703},
    R6 = {idle = 180435571, walk = 180426354, run = 180426354, jump = 125750702,
        fall = 180436148, climb = 180436334, sit = 178130996}
}
local animationProperties = {idle = "IdleAnimation", walk = "WalkAnimation", run = "RunAnimation",
    jump = "JumpAnimation", fall = "FallAnimation", climb = "ClimbAnimation", swim = "SwimAnimation"}
local function owningPart(attachment)
    local parent = attachment and attachment.Parent
    while parent and not parent:IsA("BasePart") do parent = parent.Parent end
    return parent
end
local function attachmentOffset(part, attachment)
    if attachment.Parent == part then return attachment.CFrame end
    return part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(attachment.WorldCFrame)
end
local function bottomY(frame, size)
    return frame.Position.Y - (math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y) * size.X
        + math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y) * size.Y + math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y) * size.Z) * 0.5
end

local function loadAvatar(target)
    if type(target) == "string" then
        target = target:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):gsub("^@", "")
        if target == "" then setStatus("Enter a Roblox username.", true) return end
    end
    state.version = state.version + 1
    local version = state.version
    state.selectedSnapshot = nil
    state:ClearAvatar()
    setStatus(type(target) == "table" and "Loading saved avatar..." or "Loading @" .. target .. "...")
    local model, description
    local function cancelled() return state.stopped or version ~= state.version end
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local snapshot, rigType
        if type(target) == "table" then
            snapshot = target
            description = restoreDescription(snapshot)
            rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType[snapshot.RigType]
        else
            local userId = Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(target)
            description = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(userId)
            rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
            local infoOk, info = pcall(function() return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceInfoAsync(userId) end)
            if infoOk and info.playerAvatarType == "R6" then rigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 end
            snapshot = capture(description, target, userId, rigType)
        end
        if cancelled() then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        assert(humanoid and root, "Your character is not ready.")
        model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, rigType)
        if cancelled() or player.Character ~= character then model:Destroy() model = nil return end
        local visualHumanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local visualRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        assert(visualHumanoid and visualRoot, "Avatar model is incomplete.")
        model.Name = "LocalAvatar_" .. snapshot.Username
        visualHumanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
        visualHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
        visualHumanoid.RequiresNeck = false
        visualHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
        visualHumanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
        local parts, bodyParts, feet, graph, headParts, accessories, animationIds = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
        local animate = model:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        for name, fallback in pairs(defaults[rigType.Name]) do
            local property = animationProperties[name]
            local id = property and description[property] or 0
            animationIds[name] = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id > 0 and id or fallback)
            local folder = animate and animate:FindFirstChild(name)
            local animation = folder and folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true)
            if animation and animation.AnimationId ~= "" then animationIds[name] = animation.AnimationId end
            if snapshot.AnimationIds and snapshot.AnimationIds[name] then animationIds[name] = snapshot.AnimationIds[name] end
        end
        for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:IsA("BaseScript") then object:Destroy()
            elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanTouch, object.CanQuery = true, false, false, false
                object.Massless = true
                table.insert(parts, object)
                if object.Parent == model then
                    table.insert(bodyParts, object)
                    graph[object] = {}
                    if object.Name == "LeftFoot" or object.Name == "RightFoot"
                        or object.Name == "Left Leg" or object.Name == "Right Leg" then table.insert(feet, object)
                    elseif object.Name == "Head" then headParts[object] = true end
                end
            end
        end
        visualRoot.Transparency = 1
        local function addJoint(a, b, c0, c1, joint)
            if not graph[a] or not graph[b] then return end
            local edge = {a = a, b = b, c0 = c0, c1 = c1, joint = joint}
            table.insert(graph[a], edge) table.insert(graph[b], edge)
        end
        for _, joint in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then addJoint(joint.Part0, joint.Part1, joint.C0, joint.C1, joint)
            elseif joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                local a, b = owningPart(joint.Attachment0), owningPart(joint.Attachment1)
                if graph[a] and graph[b] then
                    joint.IsKinematic = true
                    addJoint(a, b, attachmentOffset(a, joint.Attachment0), attachmentOffset(b, joint.Attachment1), joint)
                end
            end
        end
        local function solve(frame, animated)
            local poses, queue, index = {[visualRoot] = frame}, {visualRoot}, 1
            while index <= #queue do
                local part = queue[index]
                index = index + 1
                for _, edge in ipairs(graph[part]) do
                    local forward = part == edge.a
                    local other = forward and edge.b or edge.a
                    if not poses[other] then
                        local transform = animated and edge.joint.Transform or CFrame.identity
                        local relative = edge.c0 * transform * edge.c1:Inverse()
                        poses[other] = poses[part] * (forward and relative or relative:Inverse())
                        table.insert(queue, other)
                    end
                end
            end
            return poses
        end
        local neutral = solve(CFrame.identity, false)
        if rigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            local groups = {}
            for _, part in ipairs(bodyParts) do
                for _, attachment in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    if attachment:IsA("Attachment") and attachment.Name:match("RigAttachment$") then
                        groups[attachment.Name] = groups[attachment.Name] or {}
                        table.insert(groups[attachment.Name], attachment)
                    end
                end
            end
            for _ = 1, #bodyParts do
                local repaired = false
                for name, group in pairs(groups) do
                    for _, a0 in ipairs(group) do
                        if neutral[a0.Parent] then
                            for _, a1 in ipairs(group) do
                                if a0.Parent ~= a1.Parent and not neutral[a1.Parent] then
                                    local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
                                    motor.Name = name:gsub("RigAttachment$", "")
                                    motor.Part0, motor.Part1, motor.C0, motor.C1 = a0.Parent, a1.Parent, a0.CFrame, a1.CFrame
                                    motor.Parent = a1.Parent
                                    addJoint(motor.Part0, motor.Part1, motor.C0, motor.C1, motor)
                                    repaired = true
                                    neutral = solve(CFrame.identity, false)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not repaired then break end
            end
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(bodyParts) do assert(neutral[part], "Missing rig connection: " .. part.Name) end
        for _, accessory in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
                local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                local targetPart, offset
                if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                    for _, attachment in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
                        if attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
                            for _, body in ipairs(bodyParts) do
                                local match = body:FindFirstChild(attachment.Name)
                                if match and match:IsA("Attachment") then
                                    targetPart, offset = body, match.CFrame * attachment.CFrame:Inverse()
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if targetPart then break end
                    end
                    if not targetPart then
                        local weld = handle:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
                        if weld and weld:IsA("Weld") then
                            if weld.Part0 == handle and graph[weld.Part1] then targetPart, offset = weld.Part1, weld.C1 * weld.C0:Inverse()
                            elseif weld.Part1 == handle and graph[weld.Part0] then targetPart, offset = weld.Part0, weld.C0 * weld.C1:Inverse() end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, part in ipairs(accessory:GetDescendants()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            if targetPart then
                                table.insert(accessories, {part = part, target = targetPart,
                                    offset = offset * handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)})
                                if targetPart.Name == "Head" then headParts[part] = true end
                            else part.Transparency = 1 end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local lowest = math.huge
        for _, foot in ipairs(feet) do lowest = math.min(lowest, bottomY(neutral[foot], foot.Size)) end
        local visualHeight = lowest < math.huge and -lowest or visualHumanoid.HipHeight + visualRoot.Size.Y / 2
        local originalHeight = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
        if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
            originalHeight = originalHeight + (leg and leg.Size.Y or 2)
        end
        local baseOffset = visualHeight - originalHeight
        local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
        rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, model}
        rayParams.IgnoreWater, rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true, true
        local function draw(grounded)
            local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
            local direction = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            local position = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, baseOffset, 0)
            local poses = solve(CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction.Unit), true)
            local correction = 0
            if grounded then
                local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
                    Vector3.new(0, -(originalHeight + 5), 0), rayParams)
                if hit then
                    local bottom = math.huge
                    for _, foot in ipairs(feet) do bottom = math.min(bottom, bottomY(poses[foot], foot.Size)) end
                    if bottom < math.huge then correction = hit.Position.Y + 0.025 - bottom end
                end
            end
            local shift = Vector3.new(0, correction, 0)
            for _, part in ipairs(bodyParts) do part.CFrame = poses[part] + shift end
            for _, binding in ipairs(accessories) do binding.part.CFrame = poses[binding.target] * binding.offset + shift end
        end
        draw(false)
        model.Parent = workspace
        state.model = model
        local animator = visualHumanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then animator = Instance.new("Animator") animator.Parent = visualHumanoid end
        for name, id in pairs(animationIds) do
            local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            animation.Name, animation.AnimationId, animation.Parent = name, id, model
            local trackOk, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
            if trackOk then
                track.Looped = name ~= "jump"
                track.Priority = name == "idle" and Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
                state.tracks[name] = track
            else warn("Unable to load animation " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(track)) end
        end
        local sharedStatus = "Shared idle unavailable"
        local originalAnimator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if humanoid.RigType ~= visualHumanoid.RigType then sharedStatus = "Shared idle: R6/R15 mismatch"
        elseif originalAnimator and state.tracks.idle then
            local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            animation.Name, animation.AnimationId, animation.Parent = "AvatarSharedIdle", animationIds.idle, character
            state.sharedAnimation = animation
            local sharedOk, track = pcall(function() return originalAnimator:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
            if sharedOk then
                track.Looped, track.Priority = true, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                state.sharedTrack, sharedStatus = track, "Shared idle enabled"
            else animation:Destroy() state.sharedAnimation = nil warn(tostring(track)) end
        end
        local currentAnimation
        local function pauseShared()
            if state.sharedTrack and state.sharedTrack.IsPlaying then state.sharedTrack:Stop(0.15) end
        end
        local function play(name, speed)
            if not state.tracks[name] then name = "idle" end
            local track = state.tracks[name]
            if not track then return end
            if currentAnimation ~= name then
                local previous = currentAnimation and state.tracks[currentAnimation]
                if previous then previous:Stop(0.15) end
                currentAnimation = name
                track:Play(0.15)
            elseif track.Looped and not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(0.15) end
            track:AdjustSpeed(speed or 1)
        end
        local function hide(object)
            if object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Decal") then
                if state.hidden[object] == nil then state.hidden[object] = object.LocalTransparencyModifier end
                object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            end
        end
        for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do hide(object) end
        connect(character.DescendantAdded, hide, true)
        connect(RunService.PreSimulation, function()
            for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
                if part.Parent then part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery = true, false, false, false end
            end
        end, true)
        play("idle")
        connect(RunService.PreRender, function()
            if not root.Parent or not model.Parent or player.Character ~= character then pauseShared() return end
            local movementState = humanoid:GetState()
            local grounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and not humanoid.Sit
                and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
                and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing and movementState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
            draw(grounded)
            for object in pairs(state.hidden) do if object.Parent then object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end end
            local camera, head = workspace.CurrentCamera, character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local firstPerson = camera and head and (camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < 1
            for part in pairs(headParts) do part.LocalTransparencyModifier = firstPerson and 1 or 0 end
            if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                pauseShared()
                for _, track in pairs(state.tracks) do if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(0.15) end end
                return
            end
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
            local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
            if humanoid.Sit then play("sit")
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then play("jump")
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then play("fall")
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then play("climb", math.clamp(math.abs(velocity.Y) / 5, 0, 3))
            elseif movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
                if velocity.Magnitude > 1 then play("swim", math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude / 10, 0.2, 3)) else play("swimidle") end
            elseif moving and speed > 0.5 then
                if speed > 10 then play("run", math.clamp(speed / 16, 0.2, 3)) else play("walk", math.clamp(speed / 8, 0.2, 3)) end
            else play("idle") end
            local standing = movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
                or movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics or movementState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
            local localIdle = state.tracks.idle
            if state.sharedTrack and localIdle and localIdle.IsPlaying and grounded and standing
                and not humanoid.PlatformStand and not moving and speed < 0.75 and currentAnimation == "idle" then
                local shared = state.sharedTrack
                if not shared.IsPlaying then
                    shared:Play(0.2, 1, 1)
                    if shared.Length > 0 then shared.TimePosition = localIdle.TimePosition % shared.Length end
                end
                shared:AdjustSpeed(localIdle.Speed)
            else pauseShared() end
        end, true)
        snapshot.AnimationIds = animationIds
        state.selectedSnapshot = snapshot
        input.Text = snapshot.Username
        setStatus("Applied @" .. snapshot.Username .. " • " .. tostring(#snapshot.Accessories)
            .. " accessories captured\n" .. sharedStatus)
    end)
    if description then description:Destroy() end
    if not ok then
        if model then model:Destroy() end
        if not cancelled() then
            state:ClearAvatar()
            state.selectedSnapshot = nil
            setStatus(tostring(err):match("[^\n]+$") or "Loading failed.", true)
        end
        warn("Avatar changer: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

local function longQuote(text)
    local equals = ""
    while (text .. "]" .. equals .. "]"):find("]" .. equals .. "]", 1, true) ~= #text + 1 do
        equals = equals .. "="
    end
    return "[" .. equals .. "[\n" .. text .. "]" .. equals .. "]"
end

local function exportScript()
    local snapshot = state.selectedSnapshot
    if not snapshot then setStatus("Apply an avatar before exporting.", true) return end
    local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(snapshot)
    return "local SNAPSHOT_JSON = " .. longQuote(json)
        .. "\nlocal SOURCE = " .. longQuote(ENGINE_SOURCE)
        .. "\nlocal compile = assert(loadstring, 'This script requires loadstring.')"
        .. "\nlocal run = assert(compile(SOURCE))()"
        .. "\nrun(game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode(SNAPSHOT_JSON), SOURCE)\n"
end

local function idReport(snapshot)
    local lines = {"Username: " .. snapshot.Username, "UserId: " .. tostring(snapshot.UserId),
        "Rig: " .. snapshot.RigType, "Captured: " .. snapshot.CapturedAt, "", "BODY / CLOTHING / ANIMATION IDS"}
    local idProperties = {"Head", "Torso", "LeftArm", "RightArm", "LeftLeg", "RightLeg", "Face",
        "Shirt", "Pants", "GraphicTShirt", "IdleAnimation", "WalkAnimation", "RunAnimation",
        "JumpAnimation", "FallAnimation", "ClimbAnimation", "SwimAnimation", "MoodAnimation"}
    for _, name in ipairs(idProperties) do table.insert(lines, name .. ": " .. tostring(snapshot.Properties[name] or 0)) end
    table.insert(lines, "\nACCESSORIES: " .. tostring(#snapshot.Accessories))
    for index, entry in ipairs(unpackValue(snapshot.Accessories)) do
        table.insert(lines, tostring(index) .. ". " .. tostring(entry.AccessoryType)
            .. " | AssetId: " .. tostring(entry.AssetId) .. " | Layered: " .. tostring(entry.IsLayered)
            .. " | Order: " .. tostring(entry.Order or 0))
    end
    table.insert(lines, "\nRESOLVED PLAYBACK ANIMATIONS")
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(snapshot.AnimationIds or {}) do table.insert(names, name) end
    table.sort(names)
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do table.insert(lines, name .. ": " .. snapshot.AnimationIds[name]) end
    table.insert(lines, "\nEMOTES")
    local emotes = unpackValue(snapshot.Emotes or {})
    local emoteNames = {}
    for name in pairs(emotes) do table.insert(emoteNames, name) end
    table.sort(emoteNames)
    for _, name in ipairs(emoteNames) do
        local ids = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(emotes[name]) do table.insert(ids, tostring(id)) end
        table.insert(lines, name .. ": " .. table.concat(ids, ", "))
    end
    table.insert(lines, "\nFULL SNAPSHOT JSON\n" .. HttpService:JSONEncode(snapshot))
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

connect(applyButton.Activated, function() task.spawn(loadAvatar, input.Text) end)
connect(input.FocusLost, function(enterPressed) if enterPressed then task.spawn(loadAvatar, input.Text) end end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local SWORD_ASSETS = {
    ["Azure Sword"] = 10288498712,
    ["Sword Coil"] = 124393086297115,
    ["Overseer's Sword"] = 52045984,
    ["Rainbow Star Sword"] = 8287295251,
    ["Bloodlust Demon Sword"] = 256836794,

    ["Error Sword"] = 12151969733,
    ["Crowbar Weapon"] = 118433966457105,
    ["Scythe"] = 126015814826887,
    ["Water Sword"] = 9156439687,
    ["Classic Delete Tool"] = 3205241096,
    ["Trowel"] = 9016251
}

local selectedSwordName = "Azure Sword"
local isOn = false
local currentTool = nil

local function removeSword()
    if currentTool then
        currentTool:Destroy()
        currentTool = nil
    end
end

local function giveSwordTool()
    removeSword()

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if not character or not backpack then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    local assetId = SWORD_ASSETS[selectedSwordName]
    if not assetId then return end

    local success, objects = pcall(function()
        return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
    end)

    if not success or not objects or #objects == 0 then
        pcall(function()
            objects = game:GetObjects("https://assetdelivery.roblox.com/v1/asset?id=" .. tostring(assetId))
        end)
    end

    local tool
    if success and objects and #objects > 0 then
        local rawObject = objects[1]
        if rawObject:IsA("Tool") then
            tool = rawObject
        else
            tool = Instance.new("Tool")
            tool.Name = selectedSwordName
            rawObject.Parent = tool
        end
    else
        tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = selectedSwordName
        local handle = Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 4, 0.6)
        handle.Parent = tool
    end

    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    if not handle then
        handle = Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 4, 0.6)
        handle.Parent = tool
    else
        handle.Name = "Handle"
    end

    for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end

    currentTool = tool
    tool.Parent = backpack

    task.wait(0.1)
    if tool.Parent == backpack and humanoid then
        humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
    end
end

--!nocheck
local __dcm_boot = {
	hostEnv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G or {},
}

__dcm_boot.getLoader = function()
	local hostLoader = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv) == "table" and rawget(__dcm_boot.hostEnv, "loadstring") or nil
	if type(hostLoader) == "function" then
		return hostLoader
	end
	if type(loadstring) == "function" then
		return loadstring
	end
	return nil
end
local __dcm_isDelta = false
if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
	local ok, name = pcall(identifyexecutor)
	__dcm_isDelta = ok and type(name) == "string" and name:lower() == "delta"
end
if not __dcm_isDelta then
	pcall(function()
		local loader = __dcm_boot.getLoader()
		if type(loader) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		local src = game:HttpGet("https://gitlab.com/ltseverydayyou/Nameless-Admin/-/raw/main/NamelessAdminNotifications.lua")
		local chunk = loader(src, "@NamelessAdminNotifications.lua")
		if type(chunk) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		local mod = chunk()
		if type(mod) == "table" and type(mod.Notify) == "function" then
			mod.Notify({
				Title = "Delta Only",
				Description = "This script ONLY supports Delta's UI.\nTo that ScriptBlox reviewer: testing a Delta customizer on another executor and whining 'doesn't work' is a reading problem, not a script problem.",
				Duration = 9,
			})
		end
	end)
	return
end

__dcm_boot.hostGetfenv = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv.getfenv) == "function" and __dcm_boot.hostEnv.getfenv or getfenv
__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv = type(__dcm_boot.hostEnv.setfenv) == "function" and __dcm_boot.hostEnv.setfenv or setfenv
__dcm_boot.debug = rawget(__dcm_boot.hostEnv, "debug") or debug
__dcm_boot.getPrivateRegistry = function()
	local registry
	if type(getreg) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			registry = getreg()
		end)
	end
	if type(registry) ~= "table" and type(__dcm_boot.debug) == "table" and type(__dcm_boot.debug.getregistry) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			registry = __dcm_boot.debug.getregistry()
		end)
	end
	if type(registry) ~= "table" then
		registry = {}
	end
	return registry
end
__dcm_boot.ensureTable = function(host, key)
	local value = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, key) or nil
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		value = {}
		if type(host) == "table" then
			pcall(rawset, host, key, value)
			if rawget(host, key) ~= value then
				host[key] = value
			end
		end
	end
	return value
end
__dcm_boot.clearHostKey = function(host, key)
	if type(host) == "table" then
		pcall(rawset, host, key, nil)
		pcall(function()
			host[key] = nil
		end)
	end
end
__dcm_boot.clearLegacyGlobals = function(host)
	local keys = {
		"__DeltaCustomizationModuleLoaded",
		"__DeltaVisualPatchLoaded",
		"__DeltaThemeMenuPatchLoaded",
		"__DeltaHubMusicPatch",
		"DeltaIcon",
	}
	for i = 1, #keys do
		__dcm_boot.clearHostKey(host, keys[i])
	end
	local sh = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "shared") or nil
	if type(sh) == "table" and sh ~= host then
		for i = 1, #keys do
			__dcm_boot.clearHostKey(sh, keys[i])
		end
	end
end
__dcm_boot.privateRegistry = __dcm_boot.getPrivateRegistry()
__dcm_boot.privateRoot = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_boot.privateRegistry, "__nameless_admin_private")
local __dcm_env = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_boot.privateRoot, "delta_customization")
local __dcm_shared = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_env, "shared")
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv = __dcm_boot.ensureTable(__dcm_env, "runtime")

__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.shared = __dcm_shared
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv._G = __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.getgenv = function()
	return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
end
__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv.getfenv = function(target)
	if target == nil or target == 0 then
		return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
	end
	if type(__dcm_boot.hostGetfenv) == "function" then
		return __dcm_boot.hostGetfenv(target)
	end
	return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv
end

setmetatable(__dcm_boot.runtimeEnv, {
	__index = function(_, key)
		if key == "_G" then
			return __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv

local function __dcm_restoreSnapshot()
	for object in __dcm_masterRuntime.customObjects do
		if object and object.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				object:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
	for object, snapshot in __dcm_masterRuntime.objects do
		if object and snapshot.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				object.Parent = snapshot.Parent
			end)
		end
	end
	for _, target in __dcm_masterRuntime.roots do
		if target and target.Parent then
			local settings = target:FindFirstChild("Settings") or target:FindFirstChild("Settings", true)
			local holder = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Holder")
			if holder then
				for _, child in holder:GetChildren() do
					if not __dcm_masterRuntime.baseline[child] and __dcm_isCustomObject(child) then
						pcall(function()
							child:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end

				if not __dcm_masterRuntime.baseline[object] and __dcm_isCustomObject(object) then
					pcall(function()
						object:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for object, snapshot in __dcm_masterRuntime.objects do
		if object and object.Parent then
			for property, value in snapshot.Values do
				pcall(function()
					object[property] = value
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	for object, state in __dcm_masterRuntime.mutations do
		if object and object.Parent then
			local baselineSnapshot = __dcm_masterRuntime.objects[object]
			for property, wrapped in state do
				local ownedByBaseline = baselineSnapshot
					and (property == "Parent" or baselineSnapshot.Values[property] ~= nil)
				if not ownedByBaseline then
					pcall(function()
						object[property] = wrapped.value
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for object, snapshot in __dcm_masterRuntime.objects do
		if object and object.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				local original = snapshot.Attributes or {}
				for name in object:GetAttributes() do
					if original[name] == nil then
						object:SetAttribute(name, nil)
					end
				end
				for name, value in original do
					object:SetAttribute(name, value)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

		maxMoveDistance = 0

			resetState()
			return

			clickCallback()
		end
	end

	local isGuiButton = type(button.IsA) == "function" and button:IsA("GuiButton")
	if isGuiButton then
		local downSignal = getSignal(button, "MouseButton1Down")
		local upSignal = getSignal(button, "MouseButton1Up")
		local downBound = connectSignal(downSignal, function()
			beginPointer(nil)
		end)
		local upBound = connectSignal(upSignal, function()
			endPointer()
		end)
		boundPress = downBound and upBound
	end
	if not boundPress then
		local beganSignal = getSignal(button, "InputBegan")
		local endedSignal = getSignal(button, "InputEnded")
		local beganBound = connectSignal(beganSignal, function(input)
			if input and isPressInput(input.UserInputType) then
				beginPointer(input)
			end
		end)
		local endedBound = connectSignal(endedSignal, function(input)
			if input and isPressInput(input.UserInputType) then
				endPointer()

		end)

	connectSignal(changedSignal, function(input)

			return
		end
		local pos = input.Position
		if not pos then
			return
		end
		if not startPosition then
			startPosition = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
			return
		end

		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end

				end
			end
		end,
	}

			branch = branch:gsub("%%2[Ff]", "/")
			path = path:gsub("%%2[Ff]", "/")

	end

			if opts.persist == false then

			end

				return
			end

			writeJsonFile(settingsPath, settingsConfig)
		end
		local function setVis(v)
			if opts.integer then
				v = math.floor((tonumber(v) or minV) + 0.5)
			end
			v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
			local denom = maxV - minV
			local a = denom ~= 0 and ((v - minV) / denom) or 0
			fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
			kb.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
			vb.Text = opts.integer and tostring(v) or string.format("%.2f", v)
		end

			if opts.integer then
				v = math.floor((tonumber(v) or minV) + 0.5)
			end
			v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
			numValue.Value = v
			setVis(v)

			end

			local nextV = minV + (maxV - minV) * rel

				nextV = math.floor(nextV + 0.5)

				setVis(nextV)

			end
		end

	function applySidebarGestureState()
		if not sidebar then

		ensureSidebarGestureFrame()

			sidebarGestureEnabled = false

		end
		if toggleUIBtn and toggleUIBtn:IsA("ImageButton") then
			pcall(function()
				toggleUIBtn.Visible = not sidebarGestureEnabled
			end)
		end
		NAlib.disconnect("SidebarGesture")
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = false
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = false
		if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
			setIconForcedHidden(false)
			saveSidebarGesture()
			return
		end
		setIconForcedHidden(true)
		sidebarGestureFrame.Active = true
		sidebarGestureFrame.Visible = true
		applyGestureVisual()
		applyGestureSize()
		local id = "SidebarGesture"
		local function recalcGesturePosition()
			if not (mainGui and sidebar and sidebarGestureFrame) then
				return
			end
			local sgSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			if sgSize.X <= 0 or sgSize.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local sbPos = sidebar.AbsolutePosition
			local sbSize = sidebar.AbsoluteSize
			local px = sbPos.X - 8
			sidebarGestureFrame.Position = UDim2.new(px / sgSize.X, 0, 0.5, 0)
		end
		local function getSidebarAlpha()
			if not sidebar then
				return 0
			end
			local sx = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
			local denom = sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale
			if denom == 0 then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp((sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sx) / denom, 0, 1)
		end
		recalcGesturePosition()
		NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		if sidebar.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		if mainGui and mainGui.GetPropertyChangedSignal then
			NAlib.connect(id, (mainGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize")):Connect(recalcGesturePosition))
		end
		local function updateSidebarFromInput(input)
			if not sidebar or not mainGui then
				return
			end
			local dx = input.Position.X - sidebarDragStartX
			local guiSize = mainGui.AbsoluteSize
			local dist = guiSize.X * math.abs(sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale - sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale)
			if dist <= 0 then
				dist = 100
			end
			local alpha = math.clamp(sidebarDragStartAlpha - dx / dist, 0, 1)
			sidebarDragAlpha = alpha
			setSidebarPosition(
				UDim2.new(
					sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale + (sidebarOpenPos.X.Scale - sidebarClosedPos.X.Scale) * alpha,
					0,
					0.5,
					0
				)
			)
		end
		NAlib.connect(
			id,
			sidebarGestureFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if not sidebarGestureEnabled then
					return
				end
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				sidebarDragAlpha = getSidebarAlpha()

	if type(rq) == "function" then
		local ok, r = pcall(rq, {
			Url = u,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = {
				["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Http/1.1",
				["Accept"] = "application/json",
			},
		})
		if ok and r then
			body = r.Body or r.body
			status = r.StatusCode or r.Status or r.status_code or 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		local ok2, r2 = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(u)
		end)
		if ok2 and type(r2) == "string" and r2 ~= "" then
			body = r2
			status = 0
		end
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		return nil, status
	end
	local ok3, dec = pcall(function()
		return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", body)
	end)
	if ok3 then
		return dec, status
	end
	return nil, status
end

}

local function sanitizeFileName(str)
	return tostring(str or ""):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_")
end

local function hashString(str)
	local h = 0
	for i = 1, #str do
		h = (h * 31 + string.byte(str, i)) % 4294967296
	end
	return string.format("%08x", h)
end

local function clearImageCache()

	if not okExists or not exists then
		return false
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, IMAGE_CACHE_DIR)

		return false
	end
	for _, path in files do

	return pcall(makefolder, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR) == true

local function getAudioExt(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local clean = path:match("([^?#]+)") or path
	local ext = clean:match("%.([%w]+)$")
	if not ext then
		return nil
	end
	ext = ext:lower()
	return MUSIC_EXTS[ext] and ext or nil
end

local function normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	t = t:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	t = t:gsub(
		"^https://github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/blob/([^/]+)/(.+)$",
		"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/%1/%2/%3/%4"
	)
	return t
end

local function deriveAudioFileName(url, ext)
	local name = url:match("/([^/%?#]+)") or "track"
	name = name:match("([^?#]+)") or name
	local base = sanitizeFileName(name:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", ""))
	base = base ~= "" and base or "track"
	return string.format("%s_%s.%s", base, hashString(url), ext)
end

local function resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if type(full) ~= "string" or full == "" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		return nil
	end
	local okAsset, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okAsset and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function loadMusicCfg()
	if HS and type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and isfile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH) then
		local ok, data = pcall(readfile, MUSIC_CFG_PATH)
		if ok and type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
			local okDec, dec = pcall(function()
				return __lt.cm("HttpService", "JSONDecode", data)
			end)
			if okDec and type(dec) == "table" then
				musicCfg = dec
				return
			end
		end
	end
	musicCfg = {}
end

local function saveMusicCfg()
	if not (HS and type(writefile) == "function" and ensureMusicFolder()) then
		return false
	end
	return writeJsonFile(MUSIC_CFG_PATH, musicCfg)
end

local function scanMusicFiles()
	local list = {}
	if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or not ensureMusicFolder() then
		return list
	end
	local okList, files = pcall(listfiles, MUSIC_CACHE_DIR)
	if not okList or type(files) ~= "table" then
		return list
	end
	for _, path in files do
		if type(path) == "string" then
			local ext = getAudioExt(path)
			if ext then
				local name = path:match("([^/\\]+)$") or path
				list[#list + 1] = {
					path = path,
					name = name,
					asset = resolveMusicAsset(path),
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return (a.name or ""):lower() < (b.name or ""):lower()
	end)
	return list
end

local function findLocalMusicEntry(query)
	query = trim(query)
	if query == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local lower = query:lower()
	for _, item in scanMusicFiles() do
		local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
		local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
		if lower == nm or lower == base then
			return item
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function downloadMusicAsset(url)
	if
		type(getcustomasset) ~= "function"
		or type(writefile) ~= "function"
		or type(isfile) ~= "function"
		or not ensureMusicFolder()
	then
		return nil, "Custom music requires file support and getcustomasset."
	end
	local norm = normalizeAudioUrl(url)
	local ext = getAudioExt(norm)
	if not norm or not ext then
		return nil, "Unsupported audio format. Use mp3, ogg, flac, or wav."
	end
	local full = MUSIC_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveAudioFileName(norm, ext)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local data = httpGetBinary(norm)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil, "Failed to download audio."
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil, "Failed to save audio."
		end
	end
	local asset = resolveMusicAsset(full)
	if not asset then
		return nil, "Failed to load audio asset."
	end
	return {
		asset = asset,
		name = full:match("([^/\\]+)$") or full,
		path = full,
	}, nil
end

local function normalizeImageUrl(url, base)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local t = trim(url)
	if t == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^rbxassetid://") or t:match("^rbxthumb://") then
		return nil
	end
	if t:match("^https?://") then
		return t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 2) == "//" then
		return "https:" .. t
	end
	if t:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
		return (base or "") .. t
	end
	return base and (base .. "/" .. t) or t
end

local function isMeaningfulImageUrl(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return false
	end
	return not url:lower():find("no%-script")
end

function httpGetBinary(url, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local function tryRequest(hdr)
		if type(rq) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local h = {}
		if type(hdr) == "table" then
			for k, v in hdr do
				h[k] = v
			end
		end
		h["User-Agent"] = h["User-Agent"] or "Roblox/Http/1.1"
		h["Accept"] = h["Accept"] or "*/*"
		local ok, res = pcall(rq, {
			Url = url,
			Method = "GET",
			Headers = h,
		})
		if ok and res then
			local code = res.StatusCode or res.Status or res.status_code or 0
			local body = res.Body or res.body
			if (code == 0 or code >= 200 and code < 300) and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
				return body
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local data = tryRequest(headers)
	if type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then
		return data
	end
	local ok2, body2 = pcall(function()
		return game:HttpGet(url)
	end)
	if ok2 and type(body2) == "string" and body2 ~= "" then
		return body2
	end
	return tryRequest(nil)
end

local function downloadImageAsset(url)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	if not ensureImageFolder() then
		return nil
	end
	local full = IMAGE_CACHE_DIR .. "/" .. deriveImageFileName(url)
	local okEx, ex = pcall(isfile, full)
	if not (okEx and ex) then
		local host = url:match("^https?://([^/]+)") or ""
		local hdr
		if host:find("rscripts%.net") then
			hdr = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
		elseif host:find("robloxscripts%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
		elseif host:find("haxhell%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
		elseif host:find("rbxcdn%.com") then
			hdr = { Referer = "https://www.roblox.com/" }
		end
		local data = httpGetBinary(url, hdr)
		if not (type(data) == "string" and data ~= "") then
			return nil
		end
		local okW = pcall(writefile, full, data)
		if not okW then
			return nil
		end
	end
	local okA, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, full)
	if okA and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local function pick(vals)
		for _, v in vals do
			local n = normalizeImageUrl(v, SCRIPTBLOX_BASE)
			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then
				return n
			end
		end
	end
	return pick({
		d.image,
		d.imageUrl,
		d.thumbnail,
		d.coverImage,
		d.icon,
		d.game and d.game.imageUrl,
		d.game and d.game.thumbnail,
		d.game and d.game.image,
		d.game and d.game.coverImage,
		d.game and d.game.icon,
	})
end

local function resolveRoScriptsImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local url = normalizeImageUrl(d.image, ROSCRIPTS_BASE)
	if url and isMeaningfulImageUrl(url) then
		return url
	end
	local gameData = type(d.game) == "table" and d.game or nil
	url = normalizeImageUrl(gameData and gameData.image, ROSCRIPTS_BASE)
	if url and isMeaningfulImageUrl(url) then
		return url
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	if not d then
		return nil
	end
	local media = type(d.media) == "table" and d.media or {}
	local gameData = type(d.game) == "table" and d.game or {}
	local function pick(vals)

			if n and isMeaningfulImageUrl(n) then

			end
		end
	end
	return pick({

local function pass(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	if flt == "all" then
		return true
	elseif flt == "keyless" then
		return not k
	else
		return k
	end
end

local function getRw(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", true
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		local url = d.loadstring or d.rawUrl or ""
		return url, type(url) == "string" and url:match("^https?://") ~= nil
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		local source = d.script or ""
		if source ~= "" then
			return source, false
		end
		local url = d.rawScriptUrl or d.scriptLink or d.raw or ""
		return url, url ~= ""
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local links = type(d.links) == "table" and d.links or {}
		local sourceData = type(d.source) == "table" and d.source or {}
		local source = links.raw or sourceData.rawUrl or sourceData.code or d.rawScriptUrl or d.script or ""
		return source, type(source) == "string" and source:match("^https?://") ~= nil
	end
	return d.script or d.rawScript or d.scriptLink or d.raw or "", false
end

local function getTi(d)
	return d.title or d.name or "Untitled Script"
end

local function getGa(d)
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		return d.game and d.game.title or "Unknown Game"
	end
	return d.game and d.game.name or "Unknown Game"
end

local function keyReq(d)
	local v
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		v = d.keySystem
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
		v = flags.keySystem
	else
		v = d.key
	end
	if v == nil and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		v = d.accessType:lower() == "key"
	end
	local k = false
	if type(v) == "boolean" then
		k = v
	elseif type(v) == "number" then
		k = v ~= 0
	elseif type(v) == "string" then
		local s = v:lower()
		if
			s ~= ""
			and s ~= "false"
			and s ~= "0"
			and s ~= "none"
			and s ~= "n/a"
			and not s:find("no key", 1, true)
			and not s:find("keyless", 1, true)
		then
			k = true
		end
	elseif v ~= nil and v ~= false then
		k = true
	end
	return k
end

local function getInfo(d)
	local stats = type(d.stats) == "table" and d.stats or {}
	local flags = type(d.flags) == "table" and d.flags or {}
	local v = tostring(d.views or d.viewCount or stats.views or 0)
	local l = tostring(d.likes or d.likeCount or stats.likes or 0)
	local k = keyReq(d) and "Key" or "Keyless"
	if eng == "RoScripts" then
		if d.scriptType == "paid" then
			k = "Paid"
		end
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" and type(d.accessType) == "string" then
		local access = d.accessType:lower()
		if access == "paid" then
			k = "Paid"
		elseif access == "free" then
			k = "Free"
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and flags.isPaid == true then
		k = "Paid"
	end
	local s = eng == "RobloxScripts" and "Published" or (d.isPatched == true or d.patched == true or flags.patched == true) and "Patched" or "Working"
	local info = string.format("%s | Views %s | Likes %s | %s", k, v, l, s)
	if eng == "RScripts" and d.discord and d.discord ~= "" then
		info = info .. " | Discord"
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" and d.author and d.author.verified == true then
		info = info .. " | Verified"
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		if d.verified == true or type(d.owner) == "table" and d.owner.verified == true then
			info = info .. " | Verified"
		end
		if d.universal == true then
			info = info .. " | Universal"
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		local verified = flags.verified == true or type(d.author) == "table" and d.author.isScripterVerified == true
		if verified then
			info = info .. " | Verified"
		end
		if flags.mobileSupported == true then
			info = info .. " | Mobile"
		end
	end
	return info
end

local function mkCard(par, i, d)
	local rw, rwIsUrl = getRw(d)
	local placeId
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.gameId
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		placeId = d.game and (d.game.placeId or d.game.gameLink and d.game.gameLink:match("/games/(%d+)"))
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" or eng == "RoScripts" then
		placeId = d.game and d.game.placeId or d.placeId
	end
	placeId = tonumber(placeId)

	local bgUrl
	if eng == "ScriptBlox" then
		bgUrl = resolveScriptBloxImage(d)
	elseif eng == "RScripts" then
		bgUrl = resolveRScriptsImage(d)
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		bgUrl = resolveRoScriptsImage(d)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		bgUrl = resolveHaxHellImage(d)
	else
		local candidates = {
			d.image,
			d.imageUrl,
			d.thumbnail,
			d.game and d.game.iconUrl,
			d.game and d.game.image,
		}
		for _, value in candidates do
			local normalized = normalizeImageUrl(value, "https://robloxscripts.com")
			if normalized and isMeaningfulImageUrl(normalized) then
				bgUrl = normalized
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if not bgUrl and placeId then
		bgUrl = buildRobloxThumbnail(placeId)
	end
	local bgAsset = bgUrl and downloadImageAsset(bgUrl) or nil
	local bgImg = bgAsset or bgUrl

	local cd = mk("Frame", {
		Name = "Card" .. tostring(i),
		BackgroundColor3 = col.cd,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.333333343, -7, 1, 0),
		LayoutOrder = i,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Parent = par,
	}, {
		mk("UICorner", {
			CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
		}),
		mk("UIStroke", {
			Color = col.st,
			Transparency = 0.35,
		}),
	})

	if bgImg then
		mk("ImageLabel", {
			Name = "Cover",
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Image = bgImg,
			ImageTransparency = 0.1,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 0,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
		})
		mk("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Parent = cd,
			ZIndex = 1,
		}, {
			mk("UICorner", {
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
			}),
			mk("UIGradient", {
				Rotation = 90,
				Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
					NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.45),
				}),
			}),
		})
	end

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = col.tx,
		Text = getTi(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 30),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = col.ac,
		Text = getGa(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,
	})

	mk("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 50),
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = col.td,
		Text = getInfo(d),
		Parent = cd,
		ZIndex = 2,

	run.ZIndex = 3

	if cp then
		cp.ZIndex = 3

			end
			local src = rw
			if rwIsUrl then
				local headers
				if eng == "RScripts" then
					headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
				elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
					headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
				elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
					headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
				end
				local got, gotEr = httpTxt(rw, headers)
				if type(got) ~= "string" or got == "" then
					error(gotEr or "empty script source")
				end
				src = got
			end
			if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then
				error("script source must be a string, got " .. tostring(typeof and typeof(src) or type(src)))
			end
			local fn, cer = ld(src, "@ScriptHubEntry")
			if type(fn) ~= "function" then
				error(cer or "compile failed")
			end
			if type(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv) == "function" then
				pcall(__dcm_boot.hostSetfenv, fn, __dcm_boot.runtimeEnv)
			end
			fn()
		end)
		if ok then
			toast("ScriptHub", "Executed script.")
		else
			toast("ScriptHub", tostring(er))
		end
	end))

	if cp then
		con(cp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				local src = rw
				if eng == "RoScripts" and type(d.loadstring) == "string" and d.loadstring ~= "" then
					src = "loadstring(game:HttpGet(" .. string.format("%q", d.loadstring) .. "))()"
				elseif rwIsUrl then
					local headers
					if eng == "RScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = RSCRIPTS_BASE }
					elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
						headers = { Referer = "https://robloxscripts.com" }
					elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
						headers = { Referer = HAXHELL_BASE }
					end
					src = httpTxt(rw, headers)
				end
				if type(src) == "string" and src ~= "" then
					setclipboard(src)
				end
			end)
			cp.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if cp and cp.Parent then
					cp.Text = "Copy"
				end
			end)
		end))
	end

	if dc then
		con(dc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(function()
				setclipboard(extra)
			end)
			dc.Text = "Copied"
			task.delay(0.8, function()
				if dc and dc.Parent then
					dc.Text = extraLabel
				end
			end)
		end))
	end
end

local function ren()
	shClr()
	pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
	if not data or #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		return
	end
	local n = 0
	local row
	local coln = 0
	for _, d in data do
		if pass(d) then
			if not row or coln >= 3 then
				row = mkRow()
				coln = 0
			end
			n += 1
			coln += 1
			mkCard(row, n, d)
		end
	end
	if n == 0 then
		if flt == "keyless" then
			shMsg("No keyless scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		elseif flt == "key" then
			shMsg("No key-required scripts found on this page", col.wa)
		else
			shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		end
	end
end

local function setBusy(v)
	busy = v and true or false
	gob.Active = not busy
	prev.Active = not busy
	nextb.Active = not busy
	gob.Text = busy and "Loading" or "Search"
end

local function fetch(q2, tr2, p2)
	if busy then
		return
	end
	clearImageCache()
	q2 = trim(q2 or "")
	tr2 = eng == "ScriptBlox" and tr2 == true or false
	p2 = math.max(tonumber(p2) or 1, 1)
	q = q2
	tr = tr2
	cur = p2
	maxp = 1
	data = {}
	setBusy(true)
	shClr()
	shMsg("Loading...", col.td)
	local requestQuery = q2
	if eng == "RobloxScripts" and #requestQuery > 100 then
		requestQuery = requestQuery:sub(1, 100)
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" and requestQuery ~= "" and #requestQuery < 2 then
		shClr()
		shMsg("HaxHell search requires at least 2 characters", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local enc = __lt.cm("HttpService", "UrlEncode", requestQuery)
	local u
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		u = string.format("https://rscripts.net/api/v2/scripts?page=%d&orderBy=date&sort=desc", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		if requestQuery == "" then
			u = string.format("https://api.roscripts.io/v1/scripts?page=%d&max=20&sortBy=updatedAt&order=desc", p2)
		else
			u = string.format("https://api.roscripts.io/v1/scripts/search?q=%s&page=%d&max=20", enc, p2)
		end
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		p2 = math.min(p2, 200)
		cur = p2
		u = string.format("https://robloxscripts.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=newest", p2)
		if requestQuery ~= "" then
			u = u .. "&q=" .. enc
		end
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		if requestQuery == "" then
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/scripts?page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", p2)
		else
			u = string.format("https://haxhell.com/api/v1/search/scripts?q=%s&page=%d&limit=24&sort=latest", enc, p2)
		end
	elseif tr2 then
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/fetch?page=%d", p2)
	else
		u = string.format("https://scriptblox.com/api/script/search?q=%s&page=%d", enc, p2)
	end
	local dec, status = req(u)
	shClr()
	if status == 429 then
		shMsg("Rate limit reached. Try again shortly", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status == 503 then
		shMsg("API temporarily unavailable", col.wa)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif status ~= 0 and (status < 200 or status >= 300) then
		shMsg("Request failed (" .. tostring(status) .. ")", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	elseif not dec then
		shMsg("Request failed", col.er)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	local arr
	if eng == "RScripts" then
		arr = dec.scripts
		maxp = math.max(dec.info and dec.info.maxPages or 1, 1)
	elseif eng == "RoScripts" then
		local result = dec.result or {}
		local meta = dec.meta or {}
		arr = type(result.scripts) == "table" and result.scripts or {}
		local pages = tonumber(result.totalPages or meta.totalPages)
		maxp = math.max(math.floor(pages or 1), 1)
		cur = tonumber(result.page or meta.page) or p2
	elseif eng == "RobloxScripts" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		maxp = math.min(math.max(pages or 1, 1), 200)
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
	elseif eng == "HaxHell" then
		arr = dec.data
		local pg = dec.pagination or {}
		local total = tonumber(pg.total or pg.totalItems)
		local limit = tonumber(pg.limit or pg.perPage) or 24
		local pages = tonumber(pg.totalPages or pg.pages or pg.lastPage)
		if not pages and total then
			pages = math.ceil(total / math.max(limit, 1))
		end
		cur = tonumber(pg.page or pg.currentPage) or p2
		if not pages then
			pages = pg.hasMore == true and (cur + 1) or cur
		end
		maxp = math.max(math.floor(pages or 1), 1)
	else
		local r = dec.result or {}
		arr = r.scripts
		maxp = math.max(r.totalPages or 1, 1)
	end
	data = arr or {}
	if #data == 0 then
		shMsg("No scripts found", col.wa)
		pgt.Text = string.format("Page %d / %d", cur, maxp)
		setBusy(false)
		return
	end
	ren()
	setBusy(false)
end

	local savedVol = tonumber(musicCfg.volume)
	if savedVol and savedVol >= 0 and savedVol <= 1 then
		savedVol *= 10
	end
	local vl = math.clamp(savedVol or 1, 0, 10)
	local spd = math.clamp(tonumber(musicCfg.playbackSpeed) or 1, 0.5, 2)
	local mixSaveStamp = 0
	local mixReady = false
	local function queueMixSave()
		if not mixReady then
			return
		end
		mixSaveStamp += 1
		local cur = mixSaveStamp
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if cur ~= mixSaveStamp then
				return
			end
			musicCfg.volume = vl
			musicCfg.playbackSpeed = spd
			saveMusicCfg()
		end)
	end
	local function formatTime(sec)
		sec = tonumber(sec) or 0
		if sec < 0 or sec ~= sec or sec == math.huge then
			sec = 0
		end
		local total = math.floor(sec + 0.5)
		local m = math.floor(total / 60)
		local s = total % 60
		return string.format("%02d:%02d", m, s)
	end

		elseif mode == "random" then

		else
			cycleb.Text = "Cycle Off"

		end
	end
	local function getNextCycleTrack()
		local mode = st.musicCycleMode
		if mode ~= "order" and mode ~= "random" then
			return nil
		end
		local items = scanMusicFiles()
		if #items == 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local currentRaw = trim(st.musicRaw or "")
		if currentRaw == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local currentLower = currentRaw:lower()
		local currentIndex
		for i, item in items do
			local nm = (item.name or ""):lower()
			local base = nm:gsub("%.[^%.]+$", "")
			if currentLower == nm or currentLower == base then
				currentIndex = i
				break
			end
		end
		if not currentIndex then
			return nil
		end
		if mode == "random" then
			if #items == 1 then
				return items[1]
			end
			local idx = currentIndex
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				idx = math.random(1, #items)
				if idx ~= currentIndex then
					break
				end
			end
			if idx == currentIndex then
				idx = (currentIndex % #items) + 1
			end
			return items[idx]
		end
		return items[(currentIndex % #items) + 1]
	end

		skn.Position = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 0.5, 0)
		spLabel.Text = string.format("Playback speed  %.2fx", spd)

		end
		queueMixSave()
	end

	local function resolveTrackInput(text)
		local q = trim(text)
		if q == "" then
			return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
		end
		local localEntry = findLocalMusicEntry(q)
		if localEntry and localEntry.asset then
			return localEntry.asset, localEntry.name
		end
		local sid, raw = getId(q)
		if sid then
			return sid, raw
		end
		if q:match("^https?://") or q:match("^www%.") then
			local entry, err = downloadMusicAsset(q:match("^www%.") and ("https://" .. q) or q)
			if not entry then
				return nil, nil, err or "Failed to download audio."
			end
			return entry.asset, entry.name
		end
		if getAudioExt(q) then
			return nil, nil, "Local track not found in DeltaCustom/DeltaMusic."
		end
		return nil, nil, "Enter a valid asset id, filename, or audio URL."
	end
