scripts.script:
-- persistence.win — Universal Script v2.1
-- join to suggest: discord.gg/MU4W3uPf9p
-- credits to ai

--[[
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    persistence.win — Universal Hub v2.1
    Memory-leak audited & patched build
    
    Linoria UI Library
    
    Features: Fly, Aimbot, Noclip, ESP (Player + NPC), Instant Stop,
    Custom Gravity, Slope Angle, No Void, Float Platform, Waypoints,
    SpawnLocation TP, CFrame Copy, Face North, TP Tool, Latch,
    Spectate + Beam Tracer, Low HP Tracker, Death Logger,
    Potato Graphics, Instance Path Evaluator, Activity Logger,
    Script Launchers, Workspace Scanner, Performance Tracker,
    Sound Customization, Telemetry, Config/Theme Manager
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    
    join to suggest: discord.gg/MU4W3uPf9p
    credits to ai
]]

-- ============================================================
-- SERVICES
-- ============================================================
local Players            = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService         = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService   = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService       = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace          = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui         = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local Lighting           = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Stats              = game:GetService("Stats")
local Debris             = game:GetService("Debris")
local ContentProvider    = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local TeleportService    = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local ReplicatedStorage  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService       = game:GetService("SoundService")

local Camera       = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer  = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse        = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- ============================================================
-- LOAD LINORIA LIBRARY
-- ============================================================
local repo = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/violin-suzutsuki/LinoriaLib/main/"

local Library      = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. "Library.lua"))()
local ThemeManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. "addons/ThemeManager.lua"))()
local SaveManager  = loadstring(game:HttpGet(repo .. "addons/SaveManager.lua"))()

-- ============================================================
-- MASTER CONNECTION REGISTRY (for leak-free unload)
-- ============================================================
local MasterConnections = {}   -- All RBXScriptConnections stored here for cleanup
local PlayerConnections = {}   -- [Player] = {conn1, conn2, ...}

local function RegisterConnection(conn)
    table.insert(MasterConnections, conn)
    return conn
end

local function RegisterPlayerConnection(player, conn)
    if not PlayerConnections[player] then
        PlayerConnections[player] = {}
    end
    table.insert(PlayerConnections[player], conn)
    table.insert(MasterConnections, conn)
    return conn
end

local function CleanupPlayerConnections(player)
    local conns = PlayerConnections[player]
    if conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
        end
        PlayerConnections[player] = nil
    end
end

local function CleanupAllConnections()
    for _, c in ipairs(MasterConnections) do
        if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" and c.Connected then
            c:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(MasterConnections)
    table.clear(PlayerConnections)
end

-- ============================================================
-- STATE VARIABLES
-- ============================================================

-- Movement
local SpeedEnabled         = false
local SpeedValue           = 16
local JumpPowerValue       = 50
local InfiniteJumpEnabled  = false
local InstantStopEnabled   = false
local CustomGravityEnabled = false
local CustomGravityValue   = 196.2
local MaxSlopeEnabled      = false
local NoVoidEnabled        = false
local NoVoidOriginal       = nil

-- Fly
local FlyEnabled = false
local FlySpeed   = 50
local FlyBody    = nil
local FlyGyro    = nil

-- Float Platform
local FloatEnabled    = false
local FloatPlatform   = nil
local FloatOffset     = 0
local FloatMovingUp   = false
local FloatMovingDown = false

-- Noclip
local NoclipEnabled = false

-- God Mode
local GodModeEnabled = false

-- Camera
local FOVValue       = 70
local MaxZoomDistance = 128

-- Player ESP
local ESPEnabled          = false
local ESPObjects          = {}   -- [Player] = espData
local ESPFontSize         = 13
local ESPYOffset          = 3
local ESPFillTransparency = 0.5
local ESPShowDistance      = true

-- NPC ESP
local NPCESPEnabled  = false
local NPCESPObjects  = {}   -- {data, data, ...}
local NPCDestroyConns = {}  -- connections to Instance.Destroying for auto-cleanup

-- Instance Path Evaluator
local InstanceHighlights = {}

-- Aimbot
local AimbotEnabled   = false
local AimbotFOV       = 200
local AimbotSmoothing = 5
local AimbotFOVCircle = nil

-- Click TP
local ClickTPEnabled = false

-- Latch
local LatchEnabled = false
local LatchTarget  = nil
local LatchOrigin  = nil

-- Spectate
local SpectateEnabled  = false
local SpectateTarget   = nil
local SpectateBeam     = nil
local SpectateBeamAtt0 = nil
local SpectateBeamAtt1 = nil

-- Low HP Tracker
local LowHPEnabled       = false
local LowHPThreshold     = 35
local LowHPConnections   = {}   -- [Player] = {conn, ...}
local LowHPCooldowns     = {}   -- [Player] = tick()

-- Death Logger
local DeathLogEnabled    = false
local DeathLogs          = {}    -- capped at 100
local DeathConnections   = {}    -- [Player] = {conn, ...}

-- Player Activity Logger
local ActivityLogEnabled   = false
local ActivityConnections  = {}  -- named connections
local PlayerJoinTimes      = {} -- [UserId] = os.time()

-- Fullbright
local FullbrightEnabled = false
local OriginalLighting  = {}

-- Potato Graphics (weak keys so destroyed parts can be GC'd)
local PotatoEnabled = false
local OriginalMaterials = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

-- Chat Spam
local ChatSpamEnabled    = false
local ChatSpamMessage    = "Hello!"
local ChatSpamDelay      = 2
local ChatSpamGeneration = 0   -- prevents orphaned coroutines

-- Sound Customization
local SoundLowHP   = "rbxassetid://6042053626"
local SoundLeft    = "rbxassetid://6042053626"
local SoundGeneral = "rbxassetid://6042053626"
local SoundVolume  = 0.5

-- Performance Tracker
local PerfTrackerEnabled = false
local LastFPS            = 0
local FPSAccumulator     = 0
local FPSFrameCount      = 0

-- Telemetry
local TelemetryEnabled = false
local TelemetryData = {
    SessionStart   = os.time(),
    TogglesUsed    = 0,
    ButtonsPressed = 0,
    TPsPerformed   = 0,
}

-- Waypoints (up to 50)
local Waypoints     = {}
local MAX_WAYPOINTS = 50

-- Teleport Tool
local TPTool = nil

-- ============================================================
-- UTILITY FUNCTIONS
-- ============================================================

local function Notify(title, text, duration)
    Library:Notify(title .. ": " .. text, duration or 3)
end

local function PlaySound(assetId, volume)
    pcall(function()
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        s.SoundId = assetId
        s.Volume = volume or SoundVolume
        s.Parent = SoundService
        s:Play()
        -- PATCH #20: Debris fallback so sound is always cleaned up
        Debris:AddItem(s, 10)
        s.Ended:Once(function()
            s:Destroy()
        end)
    end)
end

local function GetCharacter()
    return LocalPlayer.Character
end

local function GetHumanoid()
    local char = GetCharacter()
    return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function GetRootPart()
    local char = GetCharacter()
    return char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
end

local function GetHead()
    local char = GetCharacter()
    return char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
end

local function IsAlive(player)
    local char = player and player.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    return root ~= nil
end

local function IsTeammate(player)
    if not LocalPlayer.Team then return false end
    return player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team
end

local function GetPlayerNames(excludeSelf)
    local names = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if not (excludeSelf and p == LocalPlayer) then
            table.insert(names, p.Name)
        end
    end
    return names
end

local function BumpTelemetry(field)
    if TelemetryEnabled and TelemetryData[field] then
        TelemetryData[field] += 1
    end
end

local function IsValidInstance(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst.Parent ~= nil
end

local function SafeDestroy(inst)
    if IsValidInstance(inst) then
        inst:Destroy()
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- ESP MODULE (Players) — PATCHED
-- ============================================================

local ESPModule = {}

function ESPModule:CreateESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if ESPObjects[player] then self:RemoveESP(player) end

    local espData = {}

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "ESP_Billboard"
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 60)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, ESPYOffset, 0)
    billboard.LightInfluence = 0
    billboard.MaxDistance = 2000

    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLabel.Name = "NameLabel"
    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.35, 0)
    nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    nameLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize
    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    nameLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    nameLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    nameLabel.Text = player.Name
    nameLabel.Parent = billboard

    local healthLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    healthLabel.Name = "HealthLabel"
    healthLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    healthLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.35, 0)
    healthLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.35, 0)
    healthLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    healthLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 1
    healthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    healthLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    healthLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    healthLabel.Text = "100 HP"
    healthLabel.Parent = billboard

    local distLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    distLabel.Name = "DistLabel"
    distLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    distLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0)
    distLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.7, 0)
    distLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    distLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 2
    distLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    distLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    distLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    distLabel.Text = "0m"
    distLabel.Parent = billboard

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ESP_Highlight"
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    highlight.FillTransparency = ESPFillTransparency
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

    espData.Billboard = billboard
    espData.Highlight = highlight
    espData.NameLabel = nameLabel
    espData.HealthLabel = healthLabel
    espData.DistLabel = distLabel

    ESPObjects[player] = espData
    self:AttachESP(player)

    -- PATCH #1: Clean up when character is removed (respawn/death)
    -- so we don't hold refs to destroyed instances
    if player.Character then
        local charRemovingConn
        charRemovingConn = player.Character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if parent == nil then
                -- Character was destroyed, detach GUI refs
                if espData.Billboard then
                    espData.Billboard.Adornee = nil
                    espData.Billboard.Parent = nil
                end
                if espData.Highlight and espData.Highlight.Parent then
                    espData.Highlight.Parent = nil
                end
                if charRemovingConn then
                    charRemovingConn:Disconnect()
                    charRemovingConn = nil
                end
            end
        end)
        RegisterPlayerConnection(player, charRemovingConn)
    end
end

function ESPModule:AttachESP(player)
    local espData = ESPObjects[player]
    if not espData then return end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head then
        espData.Billboard.Adornee = head
        espData.Billboard.Parent = head
    end

    -- PATCH: Verify highlight parent is valid before setting
    if char.Parent then
        espData.Highlight.Parent = char
    end
end

function ESPModule:RemoveESP(player)
    local espData = ESPObjects[player]
    if not espData then return end
    SafeDestroy(espData.Billboard)
    SafeDestroy(espData.Highlight)
    espData.Billboard = nil
    espData.Highlight = nil
    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

function ESPModule:UpdateESP()
    for player, espData in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        -- PATCH #1: Validate player still exists
        if not player or not player.Parent then
            self:RemoveESP(player)
            continue
        end

        local char = player.Character
        if not char or not char.Parent then continue end

        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myRoot = GetRootPart()

        if hum then
            local maxHP = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
            local health = math.floor(hum.Health)
            local ratio = math.clamp(hum.Health / maxHP, 0, 1)
            espData.HealthLabel.Text = health .. "/" .. math.floor(maxHP) .. " HP"
            espData.HealthLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - ratio), 255 * ratio, 0)
        end

        if root and myRoot and ESPShowDistance then
            espData.DistLabel.Text = math.floor((root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude) .. "m"
            espData.DistLabel.Visible = true
        else
            espData.DistLabel.Visible = false
        end

        espData.Billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, ESPYOffset, 0)
        espData.NameLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize
        espData.HealthLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 1
        espData.DistLabel.TextSize = ESPFontSize - 2

        -- Re-attach if adornee was lost
        if espData.Billboard.Adornee == nil or not IsValidInstance(espData.Billboard.Adornee) then
            self:AttachESP(player)
        end
    end
end

function ESPModule:EnableAll()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then self:CreateESP(player) end
    end
end

function ESPModule:DisableAll()
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        self:RemoveESP(player)
    end
end

local FlyModule = {}

function FlyModule:Enable()
    local root = GetRootPart()
    local hum = GetHumanoid()
    if not root or not hum then return end

    -- PATCH #11: Clean old instances first
    self:Disable()

    FlyBody = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    FlyBody.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    FlyBody.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    FlyBody.Parent = root

    FlyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    FlyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    FlyGyro.P = 9e4
    FlyGyro.Parent = root

    hum.PlatformStand = true
end

function FlyModule:Disable()
    local hum = GetHumanoid()
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    if FlyBody then SafeDestroy(FlyBody); FlyBody = nil end
    if FlyGyro then SafeDestroy(FlyGyro); FlyGyro = nil end
end

function FlyModule:Update()
    if not FlyEnabled then return end
    -- PATCH #11: Validate instances still exist and have parents
    if not FlyBody or not FlyBody.Parent or not FlyGyro or not FlyGyro.Parent then
        -- Re-enable if character is valid
        local root = GetRootPart()
        if root and root.Parent then
            self:Enable()
        end
        return
    end

    local root = GetRootPart()
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    local dir = Vector3.zero
    local cf = Camera.CFrame

    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cf.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cf.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cf.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cf.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end

    if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end
    FlyBody.Velocity = dir * FlySpeed
    FlyGyro.CFrame = cf
end

-- PATCH #12: Centralized cleanup
function AimbotModule:DestroyFOVCircle()
    if AimbotFOVCircle then
        pcall(function() AimbotFOVCircle:Remove() end)
        AimbotFOVCircle = nil
    end
end

function AimbotModule:UpdateFOVCircle()
    if not AimbotFOVCircle then return end
    local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    AimbotFOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(mp.X, mp.Y)
    AimbotFOVCircle.Radius = AimbotFOV
    AimbotFOVCircle.Visible = AimbotEnabled
end

function AimbotModule:GetClosestPlayer()
    local closest, closestDist = nil, AimbotFOV
    local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LocalPlayer or not IsAlive(player) or IsTeammate(player) then continue end
        local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then continue end
        local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
        if not onScreen then continue end
        local dist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - mp).Magnitude
        if dist < closestDist then closestDist = dist; closest = player end
    end
    return closest
end

function AimbotModule:AimAt(player)
    if not player then return end
    local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local targetCF = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, head.Position)
    Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCF, 1 / AimbotSmoothing)
end

        if Toggles and Toggles.SpectateToggle then
            Toggles.SpectateToggle:SetValue(false)
        end
        Notify("Spectate", "Target left, spectate disabled")
        return

    end

-- ============================================================
-- LOW HP TRACKER MODULE — PATCHED #3
-- ============================================================

local LowHPModule = {}

function LowHPModule:Enable()
    self:Disable()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then self:Watch(player) end
    end
end

function LowHPModule:Watch(player)
    if LowHPConnections[player] then return end -- already watching
    LowHPConnections[player] = {}
    LowHPCooldowns[player] = 0

    -- PATCH #3: Use CharacterAdded + HealthChanged instead of Heartbeat polling
    local function hookCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if not hum then return end

        local healthConn
        healthConn = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
            if not LowHPEnabled then return end
            if newHealth > 0 and newHealth < LowHPThreshold then
                local now = tick()
                if now - (LowHPCooldowns[player] or 0) > 5 then
                    LowHPCooldowns[player] = now
                    PlaySound(SoundLowHP, SoundVolume)
                    Notify("Low HP", player.Name .. " is at " .. math.floor(newHealth) .. " HP!", 2)
                end
            end
        end)

        if not LowHPConnections[player] then
            LowHPConnections[player] = {}
        end
        table.insert(LowHPConnections[player], healthConn)
    end

    -- Hook current character
    if player.Character then hookCharacter(player.Character) end

    -- Hook future characters
    local charAddedConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(1)
        hookCharacter(char)
    end)
    table.insert(LowHPConnections[player], charAddedConn)
end

function LowHPModule:Unwatch(player)
    local conns = LowHPConnections[player]
    if conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
        end
    end
    LowHPConnections[player] = nil
    LowHPCooldowns[player] = nil
end

function LowHPModule:Disable()
    for player in pairs(LowHPConnections) do
        self:Unwatch(player)
    end
    LowHPConnections = {}
    LowHPCooldowns = {}
end

-- ============================================================
-- DEATH LOGGER MODULE — PATCHED #4
-- ============================================================

local DeathLogModule = {}

function DeathLogModule:Enable()
    self:Disable()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        self:Watch(player)
    end
end

function DeathLogModule:Watch(player)
    -- PATCH #4: Prevent stacking connections
    if DeathConnections[player] then return end
    DeathConnections[player] = {}

    local function hookCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if not hum then return end

        local diedConn
        diedConn = hum.Died:Connect(function()
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local pos = root and root.Position or Vector3.zero
            local isVoid = pos.Y < (Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 50)
            local entry = {
                Player = player.Name,
                Position = pos,
                CFrame = root and root.CFrame or CFrame.new(),
                Time = os.date("%H:%M:%S"),
                IsVoid = isVoid,
            }
            table.insert(DeathLogs, 1, entry)
            -- PATCH #15: Cap death logs
            while #DeathLogs > 100 do
                table.remove(DeathLogs)
            end
            Notify("Death Log", player.Name .. " died at " .. entry.Time .. (isVoid and " (Void)" or ""), 4)
        end)

        if DeathConnections[player] then
            table.insert(DeathConnections[player], diedConn)
        end
    end

    if player.Character then hookCharacter(player.Character) end

    local charConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.5)
        hookCharacter(char)
    end)
    table.insert(DeathConnections[player], charConn)
end

function DeathLogModule:Unwatch(player)
    local conns = DeathConnections[player]
    if conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
        end
    end
    DeathConnections[player] = nil
end

function DeathLogModule:Disable()
    for player in pairs(DeathConnections) do
        self:Unwatch(player)
    end
    DeathConnections = {}
end

-- PLAYER ACTIVITY LOGGER — PATCHED #5, #14
-- ============================================================

local ActivityModule = {}

function ActivityModule:Enable()
    self:Disable()

    -- PATCH #14: Clear stale join times
    table.clear(PlayerJoinTimes)

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId] = os.time()
    end

    local joinConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId] = os.time()
    end)

    local leaveConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
        local joinTime = PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId]
        local duration = joinTime and (os.time() - joinTime) or 0
        local mins = math.floor(duration / 60)
        local secs = duration % 60
        PlaySound(SoundLeft, SoundVolume)
        Notify("Player Left", string.format("%s left (Session: %dm %ds)", p.Name, mins, secs), 5)
        PlayerJoinTimes[p.UserId] = nil
    end)

    -- PATCH #5: Store named for proper cleanup
    ActivityConnections = {joinConn, leaveConn}
end

function ActivityModule:Disable()
    for _, c in ipairs(ActivityConnections) do
        if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" and c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
    end
    ActivityConnections = {}
    -- PATCH #14: Clear join times
    table.clear(PlayerJoinTimes)
end

-- ============================================================
-- INSTANCE PATH EVALUATOR — PATCHED #9
-- ============================================================

local function ClearInstanceHighlights()
    for i = #InstanceHighlights, 1, -1 do
        SafeDestroy(InstanceHighlights[i])
        InstanceHighlights[i] = nil
    end
    InstanceHighlights = {}
end

local function EvaluateInstancePath(pathStr)
    -- PATCH #9: Always clear before new evaluation
    ClearInstanceHighlights()

    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return loadstring("return " .. pathStr)()
    end)

    if not success then
        Notify("Evaluator", "Error: " .. tostring(result), 4)
        return
    end

    local parts = {}
    if typeof(result) == "Instance" then
        parts = {result}
    elseif type(result) == "table" then
        parts = result
    end

    local count = 0
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if typeof(part) == "Instance" and (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Model")) then
            local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
            h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
            h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
            h.FillTransparency = 0.4
            h.OutlineTransparency = 0
            h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            h.Parent = part
            table.insert(InstanceHighlights, h)
            count += 1
        end
    end
    Notify("Evaluator", "Highlighted " .. count .. " instances", 3)
end

-- ============================================================
-- WORKSPACE SCANNER
-- ============================================================

local function ScanWorkspace()
    local anchored, unanchored, tools, npcs, playerCount = 0, 0, 0, 0, #Players:GetPlayers()

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            if obj.Anchored then anchored += 1 else unanchored += 1 end
        elseif obj:IsA("Tool") then
            tools += 1
        elseif obj:IsA("Humanoid") then
            local model = obj.Parent
            local isPlayer = false
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.Character == model then isPlayer = true; break end
            end
            if not isPlayer then npcs += 1 end
        end
    end

    return string.format(
        "Anchored: %d\nUnanchored: %d\nTools: %d\nPlayers: %d\nNPCs: %d",
        anchored, unanchored, tools, playerCount, npcs
    )
end

ChatGroup:AddToggle("ChatSpamToggle", {
    Text = "Chat Spam",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        ChatSpamEnabled = v
        BumpTelemetry("TogglesUsed")
        if v then
            ChatSpamGeneration += 1
            local myGen = ChatSpamGeneration
            task.spawn(function()
                while ChatSpamEnabled and ChatSpamGeneration == myGen do
                    pcall(function()
                        local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
                        if events then
                            local say = events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
                            if say then say:FireServer(ChatSpamMessage, "All") end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(ChatSpamDelay)
                end
            end)
        else
            -- Bump generation to kill any running coroutine
            ChatSpamGeneration += 1
        end
    end
})

})

TelemetryGroup:AddButton({
    Text = "Print Telemetry to Console (F9)",
    Func = function()
        local elapsed = os.time() - TelemetryData.SessionStart
        local mins = math.floor(elapsed / 60)
        print("═══ persistence.win TELEMETRY ═══")
        print("Session Duration: " .. mins .. " minutes")
        print("Toggles Used: " .. TelemetryData.TogglesUsed)
        print("Buttons Pressed: " .. TelemetryData.ButtonsPressed)
        print("TPs Performed: " .. TelemetryData.TPsPerformed)
        print("Active Connections: " .. #MasterConnections)
        print("ESP Objects: " .. (function() local c=0; for _ in pairs(ESPObjects) do c+=1 end; return c end)())
        print("NPC ESP Objects: " .. #NPCESPObjects)
        print("Death Logs: " .. #DeathLogs)
        print("Waypoints: " .. (function() local c=0; for _ in pairs(Waypoints) do c+=1 end; return c end)())
        print("═════════════════════════════════")
        Notify("Telemetry", "Stats printed to console (F9)")
    end
})

SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({"MenuKeybind"})
ThemeManager:SetFolder("PersistenceWin")
SaveManager:SetFolder("PersistenceWin/configs")

SaveManager:BuildConfigSection(SettingsTab)
ThemeManager:ApplyToTab(SettingsTab)

-- ============================================================
-- INPUT CONNECTIONS (all registered)
-- ============================================================

RegisterConnection(UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if InfiniteJumpEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end))

RegisterConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if ClickTPEnabled and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            local root = GetRootPart()
            if root and Mouse.Hit then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                BumpTelemetry("TPsPerformed")
            end
        end
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then FloatMovingUp = true end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then FloatMovingDown = true end
end))

RegisterConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then FloatMovingUp = false end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then FloatMovingDown = false end
end))

-- ============================================================
-- PLAYER CONNECTIONS (all registered, keyed per player) — PATCH #16, #17
-- ============================================================

local function SetupPlayerConnections(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    -- PATCH #17: Clean old connections if player somehow re-triggers
    CleanupPlayerConnections(player)

    RegisterPlayerConnection(player, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(1)
        if ESPEnabled then ESPModule:AttachESP(player) end
        -- Re-hook death logger if enabled
        if DeathLogEnabled and not DeathConnections[player] then
            DeathLogModule:Watch(player)
        end
        -- Re-hook low HP if enabled
        if LowHPEnabled and not LowHPConnections[player] then
            LowHPModule:Watch(player)
        end
    end))
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    SetupPlayerConnections(player)
end

RegisterConnection(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    SetupPlayerConnections(player)
    if ESPEnabled then
        task.wait(1)
        ESPModule:CreateESP(player)
    end
    if DeathLogEnabled then DeathLogModule:Watch(player) end
    if LowHPEnabled then LowHPModule:Watch(player) end
end))

RegisterConnection(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    ESPModule:RemoveESP(player)
    CleanupPlayerConnections(player)
    DeathLogModule:Unwatch(player)
    LowHPModule:Unwatch(player)

    -- PATCH #6: Auto-disable latch if target leaves
    if LatchEnabled and LatchTarget == player then
        LatchEnabled = false
        LatchTarget = nil
        local mr = GetRootPart()
        if mr and LatchOrigin then mr.CFrame = LatchOrigin end
        LatchOrigin = nil
        if Toggles and Toggles.LatchToggle then Toggles.LatchToggle:SetValue(false) end
        Notify("Latch", "Target left, latch disabled — returned to origin")
    end

    -- PATCH #7: Auto-disable spectate if target leaves
    if SpectateEnabled and SpectateTarget == player then
        SpectateModule:Disable()
        SpectateEnabled = false
        if Toggles and Toggles.SpectateToggle then Toggles.SpectateToggle:SetValue(false) end
        Notify("Spectate", "Target left, spectate disabled")
    end
end))

-- Local player respawn
RegisterConnection(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)
    if FlyEnabled then FlyModule:Enable() end
    if FloatEnabled then FloatModule:Enable() end
    if SpeedEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = SpeedValue end
    end
    if GodModeEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.MaxHealth = math.huge; hum.Health = math.huge end
    end
    if MaxSlopeEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.MaxSlopeAngle = 360 end
    end
    if SpectateEnabled and SpectateTarget then
        SpectateModule:CreateBeam()
    end
end))

-- ============================================================
-- INITIALIZE AIMBOT
-- ============================================================
AimbotModule:CreateFOVCircle()

-- ============================================================
-- MAIN RENDER LOOP (single connection, registered)
-- ============================================================

local perfPrintTimer = 0

RegisterConnection(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    -- Speed
    if SpeedEnabled then
        local hum = GetHumanoid()
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = SpeedValue end
    end

    -- Custom Gravity
    if CustomGravityEnabled then
        Workspace.Gravity = CustomGravityValue
    end

    -- Instant Stop
    InstantStopUpdate()

    -- Noclip
    NoclipUpdate()

    -- Fly
    FlyModule:Update()

    -- Float Platform
    FloatModule:Update()

    -- ESP
    if ESPEnabled then ESPModule:UpdateESP() end

    -- NPC ESP
    if NPCESPEnabled then NPCESPModule:Update() end

    -- Aimbot
    AimbotModule:UpdateFOVCircle()
    if AimbotEnabled and UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
        local target = AimbotModule:GetClosestPlayer()
        if target then AimbotModule:AimAt(target) end
    end

    -- Fullbright maintenance
    if FullbrightEnabled then
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 178)
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    end

    -- PATCH #6: Latch follow with validity check
    if LatchEnabled and LatchTarget then
        if not LatchTarget.Parent then
            -- Player left
            LatchEnabled = false
            local mr = GetRootPart()
            if mr and LatchOrigin then mr.CFrame = LatchOrigin end
            LatchTarget = nil; LatchOrigin = nil
            if Toggles and Toggles.LatchToggle then Toggles.LatchToggle:SetValue(false) end
        else
            local myRoot = GetRootPart()
            local tChar = LatchTarget.Character
            if tChar and myRoot then
                local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if tRoot then
                    myRoot.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- PATCH #7: Spectate validation
    SpectateModule:Validate()

    -- PATCH #19: Performance tracker using dt instead of RenderStepped:Wait()
    if PerfTrackerEnabled then
        FPSAccumulator += dt
        FPSFrameCount += 1

        perfPrintTimer += dt
        if perfPrintTimer >= 5 then
            perfPrintTimer = 0
            local avgFPS = FPSFrameCount > 0 and math.floor(FPSFrameCount / FPSAccumulator) or 0
            FPSAccumulator = 0
            FPSFrameCount = 0

            local ping = 0
            pcall(function()
                ping = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())
            end)
            local mem = 0
            pcall(function()
                mem = math.floor(Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb())
            end)
            warn(string.format("[persistence.win Perf] FPS: %d | Ping: %dms | Memory: %dMB", avgFPS, ping, mem))
        end
    end
end))

-- ============================================================
-- SET MENU TOGGLE KEYBIND
-- ============================================================
Library.ToggleKeybind = Options.MenuKeybind

-- ============================================================
-- STARTUP
-- ============================================================
Notify("persistence.win", "Loaded! RightControl to toggle menu.", 5)
PlaySound(SoundGeneral, SoundVolume)

print("[persistence.win] All modules loaded successfully!")
print("[persistence.win] join to suggest: discord.gg/MU4W3uPf9p")
print("[persistence.win] credits to ai")
print("Tabs: Movement | Combat | Players | Visuals | Teleport | Utilities | Settings")

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local Event = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MenuToys"):WaitForChild("SpawnToyRemoteFunction")

local targetPart = Instance.new("Part")
targetPart.Name = "NeonTargetIndicator"
targetPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
targetPart.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)
targetPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
targetPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
targetPart.CanCollide = false
targetPart.Anchored = true
targetPart.Parent = Workspace

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        return
    end

    local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
    local lookVector = camCFrame.LookVector
    local pitch = math.asin(lookVector.Y)
    local alpha = math.clamp((-pitch) / (math.pi / 2), 0, 1)
    local fixedOffset = -0.66 + (alpha * (-14.9 - (-0.66)))

    targetPart.Position = camCFrame.Position + (lookVector * fixedOffset)
end)

local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FastUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = pg

local unlocked = true
local buttonSize = 55
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPositions = {}
local dragMoved = false
local clickThreshold = 8

local function makeButton(parent, text, size, position)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = size
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    button.AutoButtonColor = false
    button.Active = true
    button.Parent = parent

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = button

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    stroke.Thickness = 2
    stroke.Parent = button

    return button
end

local btn = makeButton(
    gui,
    "7S",
    UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize),
    UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.4, 0)
)

local mainCorner = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local helper = Instance.new("Frame")
helper.Name = "HelperPanel"
helper.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 88)
helper.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, buttonSize + 10, 0.4, -16)
helper.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 22)
helper.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
helper.Parent = gui

local helperCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
helperCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
helperCorner.Parent = helper

local helperStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
helperStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65)
helperStroke.Thickness = 2
helperStroke.Parent = helper

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 2)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "AJUDANTE"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
title.TextSize = 13
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.Parent = helper

local spawnHelper = makeButton(
    helper,
    "spawn pattle",
    UDim2.fromOffset(58, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(7, 32)
)

local smaller = makeButton(
    helper,
    "TAM -",
    UDim2.fromOffset(38, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(69, 32)
)

local bigger = makeButton(
    helper,
    "TAM +",
    UDim2.fromOffset(38, 30),
    UDim2.fromOffset(111, 32)
)

local sizeLabel = makeButton(
    helper,
    tostring(buttonSize),
    UDim2.fromOffset(43, 22),
    UDim2.fromOffset(7, 63)
)

local lockButton = makeButton(
    helper,
    "🔓",
    UDim2.fromOffset(43, 22),
    UDim2.fromOffset(54, 63)
)

local function updatePanelPosition()
    helper.Position = UDim2.new(
        btn.Position.X.Scale,
        btn.Position.X.Offset + buttonSize + 10,
        btn.Position.Y.Scale,
        btn.Position.Y.Offset - 16
    )
end

local function setSize(newSize)
    buttonSize = math.clamp(newSize, 35, 100)

    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(buttonSize, buttonSize)
    sizeLabel.Text = tostring(buttonSize)

    updatePanelPosition()
end

local function setLocked(value)
    unlocked = not value

    if unlocked then
        lockButton.Text = "🔓"
        lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
        title.Text = "AJUDANTE"
    else
        lockButton.Text = "🔒"
        lockButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 45, 20)
        title.Text = "AJUDANTE - TRAVADO"
    end
end

local function spawnPallet()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local spawnPosition = targetPart.Position
        local camCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local _, yaw, _ = camCFrame:ToOrientation()

        local newCFrame = camCFrame.Rotation + spawnPosition
        local rotationVector = Vector3.new(0, math.deg(yaw), 0)

        pcall(function()
            Event:InvokeServer(
                "PalletLightBrown",
                newCFrame,
                rotationVector
            )
        end)
    end)
end

spawnHelper.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not dragMoved then
        spawnPallet()
    end
end)

smaller.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if unlocked then
        setSize(buttonSize - 5)
    end
end)

bigger.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if unlocked then
        setSize(buttonSize + 5)
    end
end)

lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setLocked(unlocked)
end)

local function beginDrag(input)
    if not unlocked then
        return
    end

    dragging = true
    dragMoved = false
    dragStart = input.Position

    startPositions = {
        btn = btn.Position,
        helper = helper.Position
    }

    dragInput = input
end

local function updateDrag(input)
    if not dragging or not unlocked then
        return
    end

    local delta = input.Position - dragStart

    if math.abs(delta.X) > clickThreshold
        or math.abs(delta.Y) > clickThreshold then
        dragMoved = true
    end

    if dragMoved then
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPositions.btn.X.Scale,
            startPositions.btn.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPositions.btn.Y.Scale,
            startPositions.btn.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )

        helper.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPositions.helper.X.Scale,
            startPositions.helper.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPositions.helper.Y.Scale,
            startPositions.helper.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end

local function endDrag()
    dragging = false
    dragInput = nil
end

local function connectDrag(object)
    object.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            beginDrag(input)

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    endDrag()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    object.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
end

connectDrag(btn)
connectDrag(helper)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

-- Apertar Q spawna o pallet diretamente
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        spawnPallet()
    end
end)

-- O botão 7S também spawna o pallet
btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if dragMoved then
        return
    end

    spawnPallet()
end)

setLocked(false)

scripts.script:
-- ================================================================
-- SIGMA SHADERS
-- ================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Safely remove any old versions of the GUI
if playerGui:FindFirstChild("SigmaShadersGui") then
    playerGui.SigmaShadersGui:Destroy()
end

-- Global RGB Color Cycle for UI accents
local currentRGB = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local hue = (tick() * 0.15) % 1
    currentRGB = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
end)

-- Shader Toggles State Table (All Shaders Available to Combine)
local shaderStates = {
    Bloom = false,
    ColorGrade = false,
    DepthField = false,
    SunRays = false,
    UltraShine = false
}

-- Effect Object Holders
local activeEffects = {
    Bloom = nil,
    ColorGrade = nil,
    DepthField = nil,
    SunRays = nil
}

-- Shader Engine Manager (Allows stacking multiple shaders together)
local function refreshShaderEngine()
    -- 1. Cinematic Bloom Effect
    if shaderStates.Bloom then
        if not activeEffects.Bloom then
            local b = Instance.new("BloomEffect", Lighting)
            b.Intensity = 0.85
            b.Size = 35
            b.Threshold = 0.45
            activeEffects.Bloom = b
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.Bloom then activeEffects.Bloom:Destroy(); activeEffects.Bloom = nil end
    end

    -- 2. Vibrant Color Grade Effect
    if shaderStates.ColorGrade then
        if not activeEffects.ColorGrade then
            local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
            cc.Brightness = 0.04
            cc.Contrast = 0.4
            cc.Saturation = 0.35
            cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 255)
            activeEffects.ColorGrade = cc
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.ColorGrade then activeEffects.ColorGrade:Destroy(); activeEffects.ColorGrade = nil end
    end

    -- 3. Focal Depth Blur Effect
    if shaderStates.DepthField then
        if not activeEffects.DepthField then
            local dof = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect", Lighting)
            dof.FarIntensity = 0.4
            dof.FocusDistance = 20
            dof.InFocusRadius = 22
            activeEffects.DepthField = dof
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.DepthField then activeEffects.DepthField:Destroy(); activeEffects.DepthField = nil end
    end

    -- 4. Atmospheric Sun Rays Effect
    if shaderStates.SunRays then
        if not activeEffects.SunRays then
            local sr = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect", Lighting)
            sr.Intensity = 0.5
            sr.Spread = 1
            activeEffects.SunRays = sr
        end
    else
        if activeEffects.SunRays then activeEffects.SunRays:Destroy(); activeEffects.SunRays = nil end
    end

    -- 5. 10x Ultra Shine (Mirror World)
    if shaderStates.UltraShine then
        Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Future
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 10
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 2
        Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0.1

        pcall(function()
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj.Anchored and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    -- Skip dynamic/character parts safely
                elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if obj.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic or obj.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic or obj.Material == Enum.Material.Wood then
                        obj.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
                        obj.Reflectance = 1.0
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.5
        Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.5
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- BUILD USER INTERFACE
-- ==========================================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "SigmaShadersGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.DisplayOrder = 9999
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 390)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -195)

mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local frameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
frameStroke.Thickness = 2.5
frameStroke.Parent = mainFrame

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if frameStroke and frameStroke.Parent then
        frameStroke.Color = currentRGB
    end
end)

-- Title Bar (Drag Handle)
local titleBar = Instance.new("TextButton")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20)
titleBar.AutoButtonColor = false
titleBar.Text = "   ⚡ SIGMA SHADERS HUB"
titleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleBar.TextSize = 16
titleBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleBar.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

-- Minimize Button (-)
local minButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
minButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
minButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 7)
minButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 34)
minButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minButton.TextSize = 18
minButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minButton.Text = "-"
minButton.Parent = titleBar

local minCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
minCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
minCorner.Parent = minButton

-- Content Container
local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -50)
container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
container.Parent = mainFrame

-- Shader Buttons Configuration (All 5 Combined)
local shaderButtons = {
    {Key = "Bloom", Label = "✨ Cinematic Bloom"},
    {Key = "ColorGrade", Label = "🎨 Vibrant Color Grade"},
    {Key = "DepthField", Label = "📷 Focal Depth Blur"},
    {Key = "SunRays", Label = "☀️ Atmospheric Sun Rays"},
    {Key = "UltraShine", Label = "💎 10x Ultra Shine (Mirror World)"}
}

for i, shader in ipairs(shaderButtons) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 328, 0, 46)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 12 + (i - 1) * 54)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 240)
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Text = shader.Label .. "  [ OFF ]"
    btn.Parent = container

    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    btnCorner.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        shaderStates[shader.Key] = not shaderStates[shader.Key]
        refreshShaderEngine()

        if shaderStates[shader.Key] then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 185, 90)
            btn.Text = shader.Label .. "  [ ACTIVE ]"
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
            btn.Text = shader.Label .. "  [ OFF ]"
        end
    end)
end

-- Minimize / Maximize Toggle Logic
local minimized = false
minButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    if minimized then
        minButton.Text = "+"
        mainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 50), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        container.Visible = false
    else
        minButton.Text = "-"
        mainFrame:TweenSize(UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 390), Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, 0.2, true)
        task.wait(0.1)
        container.Visible = true
    end
end)

-- Smooth Mobile & PC Window Dragging Logic
local draggingWindow = false
local dragStart, startPos

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        draggingWindow = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                draggingWindow = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if draggingWindow and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        draggingWindow = false
    end
end)

	box.TextSize=12 box.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
	box.ClearTextOnFocus=false

	local value=initial
	local dragging=false
	local function update(v)
		value=math.clamp(math.floor(v+.5),mn,mx)
		local a=(value-mn)/(mx-mn)
		fill.Size=UDim2.new(a,0,1,0)
		knob.Position=UDim2.new(a,0,.5,0)
		display.Text=tostring(value)
		box.Text=tostring(value)
		cb(value)
	end
	local function at(x)
		local w=track.AbsoluteSize.X
		if w>0 then update(mn+math.clamp((x-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/w,0,1)*(mx-mn)) end
	end
	local function begin(i)
		if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging=true at(i.Position.X)
		end
	end

	U.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then at(i.Position.X) end
	end)
	U.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging=false end
	end)
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function()

	end)

local function startFly()
	if not root or not hum then return end
	stopFly()
	fa=Instance.new("Attachment",root)
	fv=Instance.new("LinearVelocity",root)
	fv.Attachment0=fa
	fv.RelativeTo=Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	fv.VelocityConstraintMode=Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	fv.MaxForce=math.huge
	fv.VectorVelocity=Vector3.zero
	fo=Instance.new("AlignOrientation",root)
	fo.Attachment0=fa
	fo.Mode=Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	fo.MaxTorque=math.huge
	fo.Responsiveness=20
	hum.AutoRotate=false
	fc=R.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not root or not root.Parent or not hum or not fv then return end
		local cam=W.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		local m=hum.MoveDirection
		local look,right=cam.CFrame.LookVector,cam.CFrame.RightVector
		local f=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
		local s=Vector3.new(right.X,0,right.Z)
		if f.Magnitude>.001 then f=f.Unit end
		if s.Magnitude>.001 then s=s.Unit end
		local a=m:Dot(f)
		local b=m:Dot(s)
		local d=f*a+s*b+Vector3.new(0,look.Y*a,0)
		fv.VectorVelocity=d.Magnitude>.01 and d.Unit*fs or Vector3.zero
		local face=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
		if face.Magnitude>.01 then fo.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,face.Unit) end
	end)
end

local function stopFly()

    if flyConnection then

        flyConnection = nil
    end

        bv:Destroy()
        bv = nil
    end

    if bg then
        bg:Destroy()
        bg = nil
    end

        flyButton.Text = "FLY: OFF"
    end
end

-- FLY
local function Fly(estado)
    if not estado then
        stopFly()
        return
    end

    if flying then return end

    local character = LP.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root then return end

    flying = true

    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name = "DextrollFlyVelocity"
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bv.Parent = root

    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.Name = "DextrollFlyGyro"
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bg.P = 9000
    bg.D = 500
    bg.Parent = root

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying then return end

        if not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then
            stopFly()
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end

        local direction = Vector3.zero
        local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector

        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)

        if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatLook = flatLook.Unit
        end

        if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatRight = flatRight.Unit
        end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            direction = look * move:Dot(flatLook)
                + right * move:Dot(flatRight)
        end

        if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                direction += look
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                direction -= look
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                direction -= right
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                direction += right
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                direction += Vector3.yAxis
            end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                direction -= Vector3.yAxis
            end
        end

        bv.Velocity = direction.Magnitude > 0
            and direction.Unit * FLY_SPEED
            or Vector3.zero

        bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
    end)

    if flyButton then
        flyButton.Text = "FLY: ON"
    end
end

--==================================================
-- TOGGLE ARRASTÁVEL
--==================================================

local tocando = false
local arrastando = false
local inicioToque
local posicaoInicial
local inputAtivo
local LIMITE_ARRASTO = 10

toggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        tocando = true
        arrastando = false
        inicioToque = input.Position
        posicaoInicial = toggle.Position
        inputAtivo = input
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not tocando then return end

    local mouseMovendo =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

    local toqueMovendo =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        and input == inputAtivo

    if not mouseMovendo and not toqueMovendo then
        return
    end

    local delta = input.Position - inicioToque

    if delta.Magnitude > LIMITE_ARRASTO then
        arrastando = true
    end

    if arrastando then
        toggle.Position = UDim2.new(
            posicaoInicial.X.Scale,
            posicaoInicial.X.Offset + delta.X,
            posicaoInicial.Y.Scale,
            posicaoInicial.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if not tocando then return end

    local mouseSolto =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

    local toqueSolto =
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        and input == inputAtivo

    if not mouseSolto and not toqueSolto then
        return
    end

    if not arrastando then
        menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
    end

    tocando = false
    arrastando = false
    inputAtivo = nil
end)

local function findSyncAPI()
    for _, obj in ipairs(LocalPlayer:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "SyncAPI" then
            return obj
        end
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "SyncAPI" then
            return obj
        end
    end
    return nil
end

SkyboxBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local textureId = SkyboxInput.Text
    local sync = findSyncAPI()
    if not sync then return end
    local endpoint = sync.ServerEndpoint
    if textureId == "" then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local spawnCF = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
    endpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", spawnCF, workspace)
    task.wait(0.2)
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Position - spawnCF.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SetName", {part}, "Sky")
            endpoint:InvokeServer("CreateMeshes", {{["Part"] = part}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["MeshId"] = "rbxassetid://111891702759441"}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["TextureId"] = "rbxassetid://" .. textureId}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["Scale"] = Vector3.new(1000, 1000, 1000)}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, true)
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncAnchor", {{["Part"] = part, ["Anchored"] = true}})
            break
        end
    end
end)

DecalBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local textureId = DecalInput.Text
    local sync = findSyncAPI()
    if not sync then return end
    local endpoint = sync.ServerEndpoint
    if textureId == "" then return end
    local fullId = "rbxassetid://" .. textureId
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _, face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right, Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom}) do
                pcall(function()
                    endpoint:InvokeServer("CreateTextures", {{["Part"] = part, ["Face"] = face, ["TextureType"] = "Decal"}})
                end)
            end
        end

    task.wait(0.2)
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Decal") and child.Texture == "" then
                    pcall(function()
                        endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncTexture", {{["Part"] = part, ["Texture"] = child, ["Texture"] = fullId}})
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function getTargetPlayerName()
    local text = TargetInput.Text
    if text == "" or string.lower(text) == "all" then
        return "all"
    end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.sub(string.lower(p.Name), 1, string.len(text)) == string.lower(text) then
            return p.Name
        end
    end
    return text
end

local function executeHDCommand(cmdFormat, extraArg)
    local target = getTargetPlayerName()
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local success, requestCommand = pcall(function()
        return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient").Signals.RequestCommandSilent
    end)
    if success and requestCommand then
        pcall(function()
            local fullCmd
            if extraArg then
                fullCmd = string.format(cmdFormat, target, extraArg)
            else
                fullCmd = string.format(cmdFormat, target)
            end
            requestCommand:InvokeServer(fullCmd)
        end)
    end
end

--[[
    WAVE UNIVERSAL v1.7
    Roblox Studio LocalScript
    Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
]]

-- SERVICES
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- CONFIG
local LOGO_ID = "rbxassetid://115299800628540"

local themeOrder = { "Cyan", "Crimson", "Purple", "Monochrome" }
local themes = {
    Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255),
    Crimson = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 60),
    Purple = Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255),
    Monochrome = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
}

local accent = themes.Cyan
local backgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 19)
local panelColor = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 31)
local textColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)

local musicIds = {
    "1846088038",
    "1836009208",
    "9045766377",
    "9045766074",
}

-- STATE
local alive = true
local noclipEnabled = false
local infiniteJumpEnabled = false
local espEnabled = false
local musicEnabled = false

local selectedWalkSpeed = 16
local selectedJumpPower = 50
local musicIndex = 0

local connections = {}
local highlights = {}
local originalCollision = {}
local originalWalkSpeed
local originalJumpPower

local logEntries = {}
local logLabel

local sectionLabels = {}
local windowStroke
local title
local logo
local reopen
local reopenLogo
local musicToggleButton

local function track(connection)
    table.insert(connections, connection)
    return connection
end

local function log(message)
    local entry = os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. "  " .. tostring(message)
    table.insert(logEntries, entry)

    if #logEntries > 100 then
        table.remove(logEntries, 1)
    end

    if logLabel and logLabel.Parent then
        logLabel.Text = table.concat(logEntries, "\n")
    end

    print("[Wave Universal] " .. tostring(message))
end

-- PLAYER HELPERS
local function getCharacter()
    return player.Character
end

local function getHumanoid()
    local character = getCharacter()
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function saveMovementDefaults()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if not humanoid then return end

    originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
    originalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
end

saveMovementDefaults()

local function restoreMovement()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if not humanoid then return end

    if originalWalkSpeed then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed
    end

    if originalJumpPower then
        humanoid.JumpPower = originalJumpPower
    end
end

local function applyWalkSpeed(value)
    selectedWalkSpeed = value

    local humanoid = getHumanoid()
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = value

local function addSlider(parent, name, minimum, maximum, initial, callback)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.Parent = parent

    local valueLabel = makeLabel(
        holder,
        name .. ": " .. initial,
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
        UDim2.new(),
        12
    )

    local bar = Instance.new("TextButton")
    bar.Name = "SliderBar"
    bar.Text = ""
    bar.AutoButtonColor = false
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 58)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Parent = holder

    makeCorner(bar, 5)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((initial - minimum) / (maximum - minimum), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = bar

    makeCorner(fill, 5)

    local dragging = false

    local function update(input)
        local width = math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
        local fraction = math.clamp(
            (input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / width,
            0,
            1
        )

        local currentValue = math.floor(
            minimum + fraction * (maximum - minimum) + 0.5
        )

        fill.Size = UDim2.new(
            (currentValue - minimum) / (maximum - minimum),
            0,
            1,
            0
        )

        valueLabel.Text = name .. ": " .. currentValue
        callback(currentValue)
    end

    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            update(input)
        end
    end))

    track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))

    return holder
end

local function addToggle(parent, name, callback)
    local enabled = false
    local button

    button = addAction(parent, name .. ": OFF", function()
        enabled = not enabled
        button.Text = name .. ": " .. (enabled and "ON" or "OFF")
        button.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and accent or panelColor
        button.TextColor3 = enabled and Color3.new(0, 0, 0) or textColor

        callback(enabled)
        log(name .. (enabled and " enabled" or " disabled"))
    end)

    return button
end

    for playerObject, highlight in pairs(highlights) do

local function refreshESP()
    if not espEnabled then
        clearHighlights()
        return
    end

    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= player then
            local character = otherPlayer.Character
            local existing = highlights[otherPlayer]

            -- Drop highlights that belong to a dead or replaced character
            if existing and (not character or existing.Adornee ~= character) then
                existing:Destroy()
                highlights[otherPlayer] = nil
            end

            if character and not highlights[otherPlayer] then
                highlights[otherPlayer] = createHighlight(character)
            end
        end
    end
end

    music.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. musicIds[musicIndex]
    music:Play()

    log("Playing playlist track " .. musicIndex)

    -- If a track fails to load, Ended never fires, so skip ahead after a delay
    local expectedIndex = musicIndex
    task.delay(15, function()
        if musicEnabled and musicIndex == expectedIndex and not music.IsPlaying then

        end
    end)
